ev:1-absolute-luck:a-hard-landing.html: The bark tears away under your fingers, and the ground turns out to be exactly as hard as it looks. You take an injury (spend a card). Then choose again: GO TO Woodlands.

ev:1-absolute-luck:deserts.title: Deserts
ev:1-absolute-luck:deserts.html:
For an hour, the shimmer on the horizon refuses to go away. It turns out to be an oasis, and a real one: you check twice, the second time with your whole face in the water. Palm shade, sweet water, and a pool so clear you can count the coins at the bottom, thrown in for luck by travelers long gone.

Until you leave this location, you're sheltered if you rest here, and you don't spend the Desert's extra cards.

Each player may dive for the coins with a Trial 3 BODY (Athletics), and gains 3 gold if they succeed. STOP READING.

ev:1-absolute-luck:mountains.title: Mountains
ev:1-absolute-luck:mountains.html:
The mouth of a cave shelters a lit campfire undisturbed by the buffeting wind, casting its lazy light over a collection of abandoned supplies.

You gain 2x random common Travel items, and 2x random common Food items.

You may choose to rest sheltered. If you do, your first action next day is free. STOP READING.

ev:1-absolute-luck:oceans.title: Oceans
ev:1-absolute-luck:oceans.html: For once, the sea behaves. The wind holds steady at your back, the swell stays gentle, and nothing with teeth takes an interest in you. Out here, that's what luck looks like. GO TO wind continues.

ev:1-absolute-luck:plains.title: Plains
ev:1-absolute-luck:plains.html:
A stone building stands alone on the plain: a shop, in surprisingly good repair, under a sign in elaborate cursive that simply reads "Things". Beside it, a copper bowl on a stone pillar brims with gold coins, and a second sign points at them: "For the purchase of Things."

The door opens, and out steps a creature of pure black, flat as a tall man's shadow held upright. It stares at you without eyes, takes an excited hop, and bows deeply. "Customers, at last! Customers do like things, I hear. Please help yourself to some gold so you may purchase a thing."

Choose one
  • Turn around and leave. I want absolutely nothing to do with this. GO TO Leave the shop.
  • (+10 gold). Take the gold and leave. Hey, free gold! GO TO Take the gold.
  • (+10 gold). Take the gold and enter the store. GO TO Enter the shop.

ev:1-absolute-luck:the-crow-s-bargain.html: The crow considers your offer with one black eye, then the other. It flies up, works at the branch for a while, and drops something at your feet before making off with your lunch. GO TO the crow's prize.

ev:1-absolute-luck:the-crow-s-prize.html:
It's a purse stitched with a noble's crest, heavy with coin. Tangled in its strings is a little stoppered vial the crow was clearly saving for a special occasion.

You gain 8 gold and 1x random Common Potion. STOP READING.

ev:1-absolute-luck:towns.title: Towns
ev:1-absolute-luck:towns.html:
Your stomach grumbles as you lay your eyes on a bustling tavern. The sounds of music, raucous laughter, and multiple simultaneous scuffles reaches you through the thick wooden doors. Above them a weathered sign depicts a crudely drawn animal, barely recognizable under a layer of blackened grease.

GO TO tavern decision.

ev:1-absolute-luck:woodlands.title: Woodlands
ev:1-absolute-luck:woodlands.html:
A crow keeps landing on the same branch of an enormous oak, pecking at something that glints, then flying off in disgust. Whatever it is, it's shiny, it's stuck, and it's a very long way up.

Choose one
  • Climb for it. Trial 4 BODY (Athletics). If you succeed, GO TO the crow's prize. If you fail, GO TO a hard landing.
  • (Spend a Food item) Offer the crow a better deal. GO TO the crow's bargain.
  • Leave the crow to its problem. STOP READING.

ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:a-bargain.html: The voice laughs, delighted. You gain 1x random Rare Weapon and 1x random Rare Armor, and +1 curse. STOP READING.

ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:a-free-sampl.html: It tastes of pears, then of pennies. Roll the trial die. If it's positive, you feel wonderful: recover a card. If it's negative, you feel something else entirely: take an injury. If it's zero, you turn faintly purple for an hour, and that's all. STOP READING.

ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:a-loud-landi.html: You reach the valley floor faster than you meant to, and much louder. GO TO The Valley of Jewels.

ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:a-pocketful-.html:
You fill your pockets, then your boots, then your hat. You're halfway back up the cliff when the shadow crosses the sun again.

Roll the luck die. If 1-5, GO TO The Valley of Jewels. If 6-10, you make the rim before it sees you: you gain 20 gold and 1x random Rare Travel item. STOP READING.

ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:deserts.title: Deserts
ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:deserts.html:
From the canyon's rim, you can see the valley floor glitter: diamonds, rubies, gems the size of eggs, scattered like gravel among the bones of animals. The bones are the size of houses. So is the shadow that crosses the sun.

Choose one
  • Climb down and fill your pockets. Trial 6 BODY (Athletics). If you succeed, GO TO a pocketful of jewels. If you fail, GO TO a loud landing.
  • (Lose a Food item) Do what the old merchants did: throw the meat into the valley, and wait. GO TO the merchants' trick.
  • Leave the valley to its owner. STOP READING.

ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:mountains.title: Mountains
ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:mountains.html:
Nestled between two rock outcroppings lies a massive nest, crafted from sturdy branches, foliage and the occasional bone of uncertain provenance. Before you wisely decide to get on your way, the familiar glint of steel catches your eye. Something shines among the branches.

Choose one
  • Turn around and leave. No gold is worth a pecking by the avian equivalent of a pickaxe. STOP READING.
  • Approach to inspect the nest closely. GO TO approach the unidentified nest.

ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:oceans.title: Oceans
ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:oceans.html:
The sea ahead turns in a slow circle a mile wide, around a chain. It rises from the water like the trunk of an impossible tree, each link taller than a temple, and disappears into the low clouds. Frost furs the steel despite the midday sun. As you watch, the chain draws taut with a groan you feel in your teeth, and the whole ocean leans towards it.

Something at the bottom of the sea is pulling. Your raft has already begun to drift into the circle.

Choose one
  • Read the current and sail along the edge of the circle, where its pull is weakest. Trial 9 MIND (Lore). If you succeed, GO TO sail clear of the chain. If you fail, GO TO into the maelstrom.
  • (Spend a SOUL card). Pray to Adrai'lalth for deliverance. Trial 6 SOUL (Resolve). If you succeed, GO TO the chain goes slack. If you fail, GO TO into the maelstrom.
  • Steer straight for the chain. “If we can't outrun it, we climb it.” GO TO climb the chain.

ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:out-of-the-b.title: Out of the Breach
ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:out-of-the-b.html:
The breach tears wider, and whatever is on the other side comes pouring through: embers first, then legs, dozens and dozens of legs, and then the thing they belong to.

Out of the Breach
Enemies
  • 1x Emberskitter Matriarch (Crescent)
  • 1x Emberskitter Sack (Quarter)
  • 3x Emberskitter Spiderlings (Full Moon)
Rules
  • The breach closes when the Emberskitter Matriarch dies.
On Victory
  • 1x random Rare Weapon, left behind in the ashes.
  • -1 curse.
  • 8 exp for each player.
On Defeat
  • 12 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:plains.title: Plains
ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:plains.html:
The air over the burned field has split like old canvas. Through the gap you can see somewhere red, and very far down. A hand reaches through, grey and long-fingered, with a rusted iron cuff around its wrist, and beckons.

Choose one
  • Run, and don't look back. Trial 6 SOUL (Resolve). If you succeed, you don't stop until the smell of sulphur is gone. STOP READING. If you fail, GO TO you look back.
  • Take the hand. GO TO the hand's offer.
  • Close the breach, whatever comes through it. GO TO Out of the Breach.

ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:soul-in-the-.html: It doesn't hurt, exactly. The witch corks two flasks that glow faintly, and hums while she does it. You gain 2x random Rare Potion. STOP READING.

ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:strength-in-.html: You pour something of yourself into the cauldron, and ache for it. She ladles out a flask of something red and thick, still warm. You gain 1x random Rare Potion. STOP READING.

ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:thanks-for-t.html: She cackles, and waves you out with the ladle. Everyone gains 2 EXP. STOP READING.

ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:the-alchemis.html:
ItemPrice
3x random Uncommon PotionItem value
2x random Rare PotionItem value
Flask of Obliteration (Rare Potion #2)Item value

Once you're done trading, STOP READING.

ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:the-grip-tig.html: The grip tightens, and pulls. GO TO Out of the Breach.

ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:the-hand-s-o.html:
The hand is warm, and grips yours like an old friend's. A voice speaks inside your head, reasonable and a little bored. “You'll be mine in the end anyway. Why not sell early, while the price is good?”

Choose one
  • (+2 curse) Sell. GO TO the sale.
  • Haggle. Trial 10 SOUL (Influence). If you succeed, GO TO a bargain. If you fail, GO TO the grip tightens.
  • Let go. It lets you, this time. STOP READING.

ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:the-hut-on-h.title: The Hut on Hen's Legs
ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:the-hut-on-h.html:
The hut rears up, flinging its door wide, and out come the witch, her wolves, and something huge and brown that had been sleeping under the floor.

The Hut on Hen's Legs
Enemies
  • 3x Dire Wolf (Crescent)
  • 1x Grizzly Bear (Quarter)
  • 1x Orc Witch (Full Moon)
Rules
  • The hut fights too: at the end of each round, it stamps, and every player loses 1 stamina.
On Victory
  • 2x random Rare Potion, from the witch's shelves.
  • 1x random Rare item and 20 gold, from under the floorboards.
  • 8 exp for each player.
On Defeat
  • 12 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:the-merchant.html:
The meat lands among the jewels, and they stick to its fat like flies. Before long the shadow drops out of the sky, seizes the meat and carries it off to a nest on the canyon's rim, a short climb from where you stand. You wait until it leaves again, then pick the fat clean.

You gain 20 gold. STOP READING.

ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:the-sale.html: The voice names a price you hear with something other than your ears. When you look down, the goods are in your hands, and something is missing from inside you. You gain 1x random Rare Weapon and 1x random Rare Armor. STOP READING.

ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:the-valley-o.title: The Valley of Jewels
ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:the-valley-o.html:
The Roc comes down like a falling cliff.

The Valley of Jewels
Enemies
  • 1x Roc (Crescent)
On Victory
  • 40 gold.
  • 1x random Rare Travel item.
  • 8 exp for each player.
On Defeat
  • 12 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:the-witch-s-.html:
The door is opened by an orc woman in an apron, with a ladle in one hand and a string of little bottles clinking at her throat. “Guests!” she says. “Sit, sit. You'll eat first, and then we'll talk about the price.”

The stew is the best you've ever had. Afterwards, she wipes her hands and sets a cauldron on the fire. “Now. I can make you something special, if you have something to put in.”

You may rest here tonight: you're sheltered, and your first action next day is free.

Choose one
  • (Spend 2 cards) Put in your strength. GO TO strength in the pot.
  • (+1 curse) Put in a little piece of your soul. GO TO soul in the pot.
  • Thank her for the meal. GO TO thanks for the meal.

ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:towns.title: Towns
ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:towns.html:
A crooked little shop leans against the town wall, its windows fogged from the inside. The sign over the door says ALCHEMIST, and the smell agrees. Inside, an old woman with no eyebrows is stirring something that stirs back.

Choose one
  • Browse the shelves. GO TO the alchemist's shelves.
  • Accept a free sample. GO TO a free sample.
  • Leave before anything stirs back at you. STOP READING.

ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:woodlands.title: Woodlands
ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:woodlands.html:
A hut stands in the clearing on two enormous hen's legs, scratching idly at the dirt. Smoke curls from its chimney with a smell of stew, mostly wonderful. On the doorstep, a wolf the size of a pony watches you with polite interest.

Choose one
  • Back away before the hut notices you. Trial 6 BODY (Cunning). If you succeed, STOP READING. If you fail, GO TO the witch's supper.
  • Knock. GO TO the witch's supper.
  • (+2 curse) Burn it down, witch and all. GO TO The Hut on Hen's Legs.

ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:you-look-bac.html: You look back. GO TO Out of the Breach.

ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:a-door-closed-.html: He closes the door in your face, gently. STOP READING.

ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:deserts.title: Deserts
ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:deserts.html:
A thread of smoke leads you to a cave above the dunes, where a hermit lives with a goat and a great many opinions. He's been waiting a long time for someone to share them with.

Choose one
  • Sit down and listen. Trial 5 SOUL (Resolve), to stay awake. If you succeed, GO TO the hermit's prophecy. If you fail, GO TO the third age of the world.
  • Leave him to the goat. STOP READING.

ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:mountains.title: Mountains
ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:mountains.html:
Steam rises from a ring of pools high on the mountain, warm as a bath and smelling faintly of eggs. Something large and white is already sitting in the biggest one, eyes closed, humming.

Choose one
  • Share the big pool. Sit very still, and be very polite. Trial 5 SOUL (Resolve). If you succeed, GO TO the yeti's gift. If you fail, GO TO the yeti wakes.
  • Use the small pools. GO TO the small pools.
  • Leave the yeti to its bath. STOP READING.

ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:oceans.title: Oceans
ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:oceans.html:
A little island rises out of the sea, green and quiet, with a spring and a stand of palms. You haul the raft up its beach, drink your fill, and stretch out in the shade. Then the island sneezes.

Everyone takes a Trial 4 BODY (Athletics) to reach the raft before the island dives. Each player who fails takes an injury.

The island surfaces again a mile away, and swims off with a long, contented groan. GO TO sail on.

ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:plains.title: Plains
ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:plains.html:
A merchant wagon lists at an alarming angle beside the road. Three armored guards stand around it, looking sternly at a wheel sunk to its axle in mud. Their employer sits on a crate, fanning herself with a ledger.

“Excellent,” she calls. “Someone without a contract forbidding manual labor.”

Choose one
  • Leave them to negotiate. STOP READING.
  • Put your shoulder to the wheel and shame the guards into pushing with you. Trial 5 SOUL (Might, Influence). If you succeed, GO TO the wheel comes free. If you fail, GO TO the wagon settles deeper.

ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:the-gilded-goo.html:
Inside, the wine is good, the harpist is better, and the gossip is the best in town.

Everyone gains 1 EXP, and you hear rumours of one special location on this landmass: turn to its page, and read only its rumour section.

If you rest in this town tonight, you may take rooms here for 2 gold each. If you do, your first action next day is free. STOP READING.

ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:the-hermit-s-p.html:
At dawn he finally stops, looks at you properly, and nods. “You listened. Nobody listens.” He digs in the sand at the back of the cave, and hands you something wrapped in goatskin. As you leave, he calls after you: “Everyone thinks a chain has two ends. Everyone!”

You gain 1x random Rare Travel item. Everyone gains 2 EXP. STOP READING.

ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:the-small-pool.html: The water is hot enough to boil the ache out of your bones. Each player recovers a card. STOP READING.

ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:the-third-age-.html: You nod off somewhere in the third age of the world, and wake at dawn with sand in your ears. He's still talking. STOP READING.

ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:the-wagon-sett.html: The guards discover a sudden interest in the horizon, and the wagon settles deeper. STOP READING.

ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:the-wheel-come.html: Three armored backs join yours, and the wheel comes free with a wet pop. The merchant pays you, and pointedly doesn't pay them. You gain 4 gold. STOP READING.

ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:the-yeti-s-gif.html:
You soak in companionable silence for an hour. When you finally climb out, the yeti fishes something up from the bottom of its pool and presses it into your hand, still steaming: an egg the size of your head, boiled to perfection.

Each player recovers 2 cards. You gain Giant Egg (Rare Food #1). STOP READING.

ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:the-yeti-wakes.html: The yeti opens one eye, then its mouth, and you leave in a hurry. You take an injury. STOP READING.

ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:towns.title: Towns
ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:towns.html:
Off the main square, a tall townhouse glows behind leaded windows. A gilded goose hangs over its door, and whenever the door opens, harp music drifts out into the street. The doorman steps into your path. His only job, it seems, is to look at people the way he's looking at you now.

Choose one
  • (-5 gold) Pay the doorman's “Shackle surcharge”. GO TO the Gilded Goose.
  • Remind him that the Shackle isn't catching. Trial 6 MIND (Influence). If you succeed, GO TO the Gilded Goose. If you fail, GO TO a door closed gently.
  • Find somewhere cheaper. STOP READING.

ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:woodlands.title: Woodlands
ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:woodlands.html:
Tucked away beneath thick foliage, you notice the hard wooden edge of a chest. Though you can't make it out in its entirety behind the leaves, it appears sturdy and unspoiled by rot.

Trial 4 MIND (Cunning). If you succeed, GO TO avoiding the trap. If you fail, keep reading.

Choose one
  • Turn around and leave. Not worth the risk. STOP READING.
  • Approach it. Continue reading.

You begin to hack away at the foliage, slowly carving a path to the chest. As wet branches crushed underfoot join the sound of your knife, you notice a metallic glint by the corner of your eye.

GO TO Booby trapped chest.

ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:a-few-good-storie.html: The witch pours you a cup of something that smokes, and the war band lets you pass, for the price of a few good stories. Everyone gains 1 EXP. STOP READING.

ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:a-frog-in-the-thr.title: A Frog in the Throat
ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:a-frog-in-the-thr.html:
The frogs don't want to go overboard. They make this very clear.

A Frog in the Throat
Enemies
  • 4x Warpfrog (Crescent)
On Victory
  • If you carry the Magister's jar, a frog hops into it: you have a frog in a jar.
  • 3 exp for each player.
On Defeat
  • Each player loses 1x Food item: the frogs ate it.
  • 5 exp for each player.

After the encounter, GO TO sail on.

ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:deserts.title: Deserts
ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:deserts.html:
From the ridge, you watch raiders fall on a merchant caravan in the valley below. The caravan's guards are holding, but only just.

Choose one
  • Ride to the caravan's rescue. GO TO Sand in the Wheels.
  • (+2 curse) Join the raiders, for a share of the spoils. GO TO Honor Among Thieves.
  • Wait for it to be over. STOP READING.

ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:grin-and-bear-it.title: Grin and Bear It
ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:grin-and-bear-it.html:
The mother comes out of the bracken like a landslide with teeth, and the father, it turns out, was never far away.

Grin and Bear It
Enemies
  • 2x Grizzly Bear (Quarter)
On Victory
  • 2x Beast Meat (Common Food #7).
  • 4 exp for each player.
On Defeat
  • 6 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:honor-among-thiev.title: Honor Among Thieves
ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:honor-among-thiev.html:
The raiders make room for you without a word. The caravan's guards are sladeri mercenaries, and they close ranks as you come.

Honor Among Thieves
Enemies
  • 2x Ironclad Soldier (Quarter), the guards.
  • 1x Ironclad Ranger (Full Moon), on the wagons.
On Victory
  • Your share of the spoils: 30 gold, 1x random Rare item and 1x random Uncommon Travel item.
  • 4 exp for each player.
On Defeat
  • 6 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:mountains.title: Mountains
ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:mountains.html:
An orc war band is camped in the pass, most of it snoring off last night. The wolves tethered by the fire aren't asleep, and neither is the witch stirring the cauldron. She looks up, straight at you, and smiles.

Choose one
  • Walk into the camp with your hands open. Trial 6 SOUL (Influence). If you succeed, GO TO a few good stories. If you fail, GO TO Pass Fail.
  • Attack while they sleep. GO TO Pass Fail.
  • Go back the way you came. STOP READING.

ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:oceans.title: Oceans
ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:oceans.html:
The sky is clear, the sea is calm, and it's raining frogs. They land on the raft with wet little slaps, blink out of existence, and blink back in somewhere worse: in your boots, in the water barrel, on your face. Somewhere, a wizard is having a very bad day.

Choose one
  • Bail them overboard. GO TO A Frog in the Throat.
  • (Everyone spends a card) Row out from under the cloud. GO TO out from under the cloud.

ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:out-from-under-th.html: You row until the frogs stop falling, and then a little further, to be sure. GO TO sail on.

ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:pass-fail.title: Pass Fail
ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:pass-fail.html:
The witch whistles, and the wolves slip their tethers. Behind her, the war band goes on snoring.

Pass Fail
Enemies
  • 3x Dire Wolf (Quarter)
  • 1x Orc Witch (Full Moon)
On Victory
  • 6 gold.
  • 1x random Uncommon Weapon.
  • 4 exp for each player.
On Defeat
  • 6 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:plains.title: Plains
ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:plains.html:
Hunting horns sound across the grassland, and a party of riders crests the hill: a baron in green velvet, with his huntsmen and his guards. He reins in, looks you over, and brightens. “Shackled! Splendid. The deer were getting predictable.”

Choose one
  • Remind him that hunting people is frowned upon, even the Shackled kind. Trial 6 SOUL (Influence). If you succeed, GO TO the baron sulks. If you fail, GO TO The Most Dangerous Game.
  • Stand and fight. GO TO The Most Dangerous Game.

ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:protection-money.title: Protection Money
ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:protection-money.html:
The thin man sighs, and the alley fills up with his colleagues.

Protection Money
Enemies
  • 3x Bandit (Crescent), the guild's muscle.
  • 1x Ringleader (Quarter), the thin man.
On Victory
  • The day's collections: 8 gold.
  • 4 exp for each player.
On Defeat
  • Everyone loses half their gold, rounded up.
  • 6 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:sand-in-the-wheel.title: Sand in the Wheels
ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:sand-in-the-wheel.html:
You hit the raiders from behind, and for a moment, they don't know which way to face.

Sand in the Wheels
Enemies
  • 4x Bandit (Quarter), the raiders.
On Victory
  • The grateful merchant pays you: 10 gold and 1x random Uncommon Travel item.
  • 4 exp for each player.
On Defeat
  • 6 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:someone-else.html: He considers this, and decides the guild has noticed someone else. STOP READING.

ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:the-baron-sulks.html: He sulks, and rides off to be predictable at the deer. STOP READING.

ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:the-most-dangerou.title: The Most Dangerous Game
ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:the-most-dangerou.html:
The baron blows his horn, and his huntsmen spread out through the grass while his guards close in, laughing.

The Most Dangerous Game
Enemies
  • 2x Royal Guard (Quarter), the baron's guards.
  • 2x Poacher (Full Moon), his huntsmen.
On Victory
  • The baron flees, and leaves his purse behind: 8 gold.
  • 1x random Uncommon Weapon.
  • 4 exp for each player.
On Defeat
  • 6 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:towns.title: Towns
ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:towns.html:
You cut through a narrow alley to avoid the market crowds. A thin man falls into step beside you, and two large ones fall into step behind. “The guild,” says the thin one, “has noticed you. The guild likes to be paid for noticing.”

Choose one
  • (Everyone loses 3 gold) Pay. “Pleasure doing business.” STOP READING.
  • Explain that the Shackled make very poor victims. Trial 6 MIND (Influence). If you succeed, GO TO someone else. If you fail, GO TO Protection Money.
  • Refuse. GO TO Protection Money.

ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:woodlands.title: Woodlands
ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:woodlands.html:
Two bear cubs tumble out of the bracken, see you, and squeak. Somewhere behind them, something much bigger stops eating.

Choose one
  • Back away slowly. Trial 5 BODY (Cunning). If you succeed, the cubs lose interest, and so, thankfully, does their mother. STOP READING. If you fail, GO TO Grin and Bear It.
  • Stand your ground. GO TO Grin and Bear It.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:a-rude-awakening.title: A Rude Awakening
ev:13-the-relic-seller:a-rude-awakening.html:
The monk sets down her tray, very carefully, and bows. So do the three brothers who appear behind her, from nowhere, in total silence.

A Rude Awakening
Enemies
  • 3x Brawler (Quarter), the monks.
On Victory
  • The monastery's offerings: 25 gold, 2x Rice Balls (Uncommon Food #3), Wooden Beads (Uncommon Travel #5) and 1x random Rare Travel item.
  • 4 exp for each player.
On Defeat
  • 6 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:an-arrow-escape.title: An Arrow Escape
ev:13-the-relic-seller:an-arrow-escape.html:
Your shot goes wide. Theirs, you suspect, won't.

An Arrow Escape
Enemies
  • 3x Poacher (Crescent), the elves in the branches.
On Victory
  • Longbow (Common Weapon #6), 1x random Rare Weapon and 1x random Uncommon Food item.
  • 4 exp for each player.
On Defeat
  • 6 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:caught-red-handed.title: Caught Red-Handed
ev:13-the-relic-seller:caught-red-handed.html:
A sentry's lamp swings round, and the whole camp wakes at once, the way only soldiers can.

Caught Red-Handed
Enemies
  • 2x Ironclad Soldier (Crescent)
  • 1x Ironclad Protector (Quarter)
On Victory
  • 1x random Rare Weapon and 1x random Uncommon Armor, from the wagon.
  • 4 exp for each player.
On Defeat
  • Everyone loses half their gold, rounded up: the sladeri charge for their trouble.
  • 6 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:deserts.title: Deserts
ev:13-the-relic-seller:deserts.html:
A mercenary camp sprawls around a well: sladeri, in iron and scarves, resting between contracts. Their quartermaster runs a stall from the back of a wagon. To her, business is business, Shackled or not.

ItemPrice
2x random Common WeaponItem value
2x random Uncommon ArmorItem value
1x random Rare WeaponItem value + 3 gold
Choose one
  • Trade, and go on your way. STOP READING.
  • (+1 curse) Come back after dark, and help yourselves. Trial 6 BODY (Cunning). If you succeed, GO TO the best blade on the wagon. If you fail, GO TO Caught Red-Handed.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:holy-orders.title: Holy Orders
ev:13-the-relic-seller:holy-orders.html:
The pilgrim squeals, and two large men who had been napping under the cart remember what they're paid for.

Holy Orders
Enemies
  • 2x Ironclad Protector (Quarter), his guards.
On Victory
  • His takings: 25 gold, Wooden Beads (Uncommon Travel #5) and 2x random Uncommon Potion, the goddess's tears.
  • 4 exp for each player.
On Defeat
  • 6 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:mountains.title: Mountains
ev:13-the-relic-seller:mountains.html:
A monastery clings to the cliff above the path, all red roofs and prayer flags, and a bell rings as you climb towards it. At the gate, a monk in saffron waits with a tray of tea, as if she'd been expecting you.

Choose one
  • Accept the tea, and see what the monks have to offer. GO TO the monks' offerings.
  • (+2 curse) Knock the tray aside, and rob the place. GO TO A Rude Awakening.
  • Keep climbing. STOP READING.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:oceans.title: Oceans
ev:13-the-relic-seller:oceans.html:
A tentacle as thick as a mast rises beside the raft, feels its way along the logs like a blind man reading, and finds your ankle.

Choose one
  • (Lose a Food item) Offer it something tastier. The tentacle takes the food, considers it, and lets go. GO TO sail on.
  • Keep perfectly still, and remember what the old sailors say about krakens. Trial 7 MIND (Lore). If you succeed, GO TO the soft spot. If you fail, GO TO the kraken pulls.
  • Hack at it. Trial 6 BODY x player (Might). If you succeed, GO TO the tentacle lets go. If you fail, GO TO the kraken pulls.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:plains.title: Plains
ev:13-the-relic-seller:plains.html:
A painted cart stands at the crossroads, hung with little bells and a portrait of Adrai'lalth that someone has touched up, generously, in gold leaf. Its owner, a round man in a pilgrim's robe, spreads his arms at the sight of you. “Pilgrims! Relics, blessings, holy water. Everything the faithful need, at prices the faithful can afford.”

Choose one
  • Look over his relics. GO TO the relic cart.
  • (+1 curse) Relieve him of his takings. GO TO Holy Orders.
  • Keep walking. STOP READING.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:she-only-watches.html: The painted goddess only watches. STOP READING.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:she-s-listening.html: For a moment, you're sure she's listening. Everyone gains 2 EXP. STOP READING.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:tended.html: The priestess binds your wounds quickly, and well, and doesn't meet your eyes. Each player who paid recovers a card. STOP READING.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:the-best-blade-on.html: You slip out of the camp with the best blade on the wagon. You gain 1x random Rare Weapon and 1x random Uncommon Armor. STOP READING.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:the-elves-wares.html:
They drop from the branches without a sound, and unroll a cloak on the moss.

ItemPrice
2x random Uncommon Food itemItem value
Longbow (Common Weapon #6)Item value
1x random Uncommon PotionItem value
1x random Rare WeaponItem value

Once you're done trading, STOP READING.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:the-kraken-pulls.html: The tentacle tightens, and pulls. The raft tilts, then flips, and the sea is full of legs. GO TO Shipwrecked.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:the-monks-offerin.html:
The monks sell what they make: prayer beads, tea, and rice wrapped in leaves. For those who need it, they also offer a night of silence.

ItemPrice
Wooden Beads (Uncommon Travel #5)Item value
2x Rice Balls (Uncommon Food #3)Item value
A night in the monastery3 gold each

If you pay for a night in the monastery, you rest here tonight, sheltered, and your first action next day is free. Each player who paid gains 2 EXP from the evening's meditation.

Once you're done trading, STOP READING.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:the-next-arrow.html: The next arrow lands a finger from your boot. STOP READING.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:the-offering.html: The priestess drops your coins into the box without looking at them, or at you. That night, for the first time in a long while, you sleep without dreaming of chains. You made an offering to the goddess. -1 curse. STOP READING.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:the-relic-cart.html:
A finger bone of Saint Oswin. A splinter from the goddess's cradle. A vial of her tears, slightly cloudy.

Trial 6 SOUL (Resolve), to tell the holy from the hopeful. If you succeed, you find the few real things among the fakes, and he knows that you know: you may buy anything below for half its price. If you fail, you pay in full.

ItemPrice
Wooden Beads (Uncommon Travel #5)Item value
2x random Uncommon Potion, the goddess's tearsItem value
1x random Rare Travel itemItem value

Once you're done trading, STOP READING.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:the-soft-spot.html: You find the soft spot behind the suckers, and pinch. The tentacle recoils. Everyone gains 2 EXP. GO TO sail on.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:the-tentacle-lets.html: The tentacle lets go, and the sea boils as something vast sulks away. GO TO sail on.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:towns.title: Towns
ev:13-the-relic-seller:towns.html:
The town's temple of Adrai'lalth is small, and very clean. A priestess is sweeping the steps as you arrive. She sees the Shackle and stops sweeping, then, after a moment, starts again, a little faster. Inside, the goddess watches from the painted wall, one hand raised in blessing. The other hand is behind her back.

Choose one
  • (Lose 20 gold, without an offering to the goddess) Make an offering. GO TO the offering.
  • (3 gold for each player tended) Ask to be tended. GO TO tended.
  • Pray. Trial 6 SOUL (Resolve). If you succeed, GO TO she's listening. If you fail, GO TO she only watches.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:woodlands.title: Woodlands
ev:13-the-relic-seller:woodlands.html:
Three arrows thud into the tree beside your head, in a neat line. In the branches above, three elves sit with their bows drawn, looking bored. “Stop there, Shackled,” says one, in the tone of someone who has said it many times. “State your business in our wood.”

Choose one
  • Ask to trade. Elves don't trade with just anyone. Trial 6 SOUL (Influence). If you succeed, GO TO the elves' wares. If you fail, GO TO the next arrow.
  • (+1 curse) Shoot first. GO TO An Arrow Escape.
  • Turn back. STOP READING.

ev:14-tolls-of-war:a-successful-experime.html: Nothing hatches. The wizard pays you in coin and gratitude, mostly for that. You gain 8 gold. Everyone gains 2 EXP. STOP READING.

ev:14-tolls-of-war:deserts.title: Deserts
ev:14-tolls-of-war:deserts.html:
A dust cloud on the horizon resolves into riders in white and gold, the emir's banner snapping over them. Their captain reins in beside you. “By order of the Emir, all travelers pay the water tax.” He looks at your waterskins. “Half.”

Choose one
  • (Everyone spends a card) Pay, and go thirsty. STOP READING.
  • Refuse. GO TO Tax Evasion.

ev:14-tolls-of-war:experimental-results.title: Experimental Results
ev:14-tolls-of-war:experimental-results.html:
Something in the jar you're holding goes tick. The wizard says a word they don't teach at the academy, and the jar hatches.

Experimental Results
Enemies
  • 3x Emberskitter Spiderlings (Crescent)
On Victory
  • The wizard, singed, pays you anyway: 6 gold.
  • 3 exp for each player.
On Defeat
  • 5 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:14-tolls-of-war:fairy-ring.title: Fairy Ring
ev:14-tolls-of-war:fairy-ring.html:
The moment your foot crosses the mushrooms, every frog in the ring turns to face you at once.

Fairy Ring
Enemies
  • 4x Warpfrog (Crescent)
On Victory
  • If you carry the Magister's jar, a frog hops into it: you have a frog in a jar.
  • 3 exp for each player.
On Defeat
  • 5 exp for each player.

If you lost, you wake up outside the ring, some distance away: move to a random adjacent location. STOP READING. If you won, the ring is yours to use, once: you and your allies may move to any location up to 3 locations away. STOP READING.

ev:14-tolls-of-war:knives-out.title: Knives Out
ev:14-tolls-of-war:knives-out.html:
The pirates come over the side all at once, and their captain comes last, still grinning.

Knives Out
Enemies
  • 3x Bandit (Crescent), the pirates.
  • 1x Ringleader (Quarter), their captain.
On Victory
  • 8 gold.
  • 4 exp for each player.
On Defeat
  • Each player loses an item of common or uncommon rarity.
  • 6 exp for each player.

Win or lose, the longboat rows away. GO TO sail on.

ev:14-tolls-of-war:mountains.title: Mountains
ev:14-tolls-of-war:mountains.html:
Someone has built a wall across the pass, with a gate and a squat stone tower, and a dwarf in a very large helmet is leaning out of its window. “Toll,” he says. “Two gold a head. Five for Shackled.”

Choose one
  • (Everyone loses 5 gold) Pay. STOP READING.
  • Argue that the Shackled are people too. Trial 7 SOUL (Influence). If you succeed, GO TO the normal rate. If you fail, choose a different option.
  • Go over the wall. GO TO Tolls of War.

ev:14-tolls-of-war:oceans.title: Oceans
ev:14-tolls-of-war:oceans.html:
A longboat full of pirates pulls alongside, and a woman with a knife in each hand stands in its bow, grinning. “Nice raft,” she says. “We'll take whatever's on it.”

Choose one
  • (Each player loses an item of common or uncommon rarity) Hand over your valuables. “Pleasure doing business.” GO TO sail on.
  • Fight for your belongings. GO TO Knives Out.

ev:14-tolls-of-war:plains.title: Plains
ev:14-tolls-of-war:plains.html:
A grass fire has swept this stretch of the plains, leaving it black to the horizon. The flames are long gone, but the smoke isn't. It drifts low over the ash in little clouds, against the wind, and it's drifting towards you.

Choose one
  • Outrun it. Trial 6 SOUL (Resolve). If you succeed, you leave it grumbling in the ash. STOP READING. If you fail, GO TO Up in Smoke.
  • Stand your ground. GO TO Up in Smoke.

ev:14-tolls-of-war:tax-evasion.title: Tax Evasion
ev:14-tolls-of-war:tax-evasion.html:
The captain sighs, the way officials do everywhere, and his riders draw their swords.

Tax Evasion
Enemies
  • 3x Royal Guard (Quarter), the emir's riders.
On Victory
  • 8 gold and 1x random Uncommon Armor, from the riders' saddlebags.
  • 4 exp for each player.
On Defeat
  • The riders take their tax anyway: everyone spends a card.
  • 6 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:14-tolls-of-war:the-normal-rate.html: He grumbles, and charges you the normal rate. Everyone loses 2 gold. STOP READING.

ev:14-tolls-of-war:the-wizard-s-wares.html:
The wizard's shelves groan with wands, staves, and jars of things that are mostly dead.

ItemPrice
Birch Wand (Common Weapon #3)Item value
Oak Staff (Common Weapon #4)Item value
Chromatic Staff (Uncommon Weapon #2)Item value
2x random Uncommon PotionItem value
1x random Rare PotionItem value

Once you're done trading, STOP READING.

ev:14-tolls-of-war:tolls-of-war.title: Tolls of War
ev:14-tolls-of-war:tolls-of-war.html:
You're halfway up the wall when the helmet shouts something in dwarvish, and the tower empties.

Tolls of War
Enemies
  • 2x Ironclad Protector (Quarter), the gate's guards.
  • 1x Ironclad Ranger (Full Moon), the dwarf in the tower.
On Victory
  • The toll box: 12 gold.
  • 4 exp for each player.
On Defeat
  • Everyone loses 5 gold: the toll, and a fine.
  • 6 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:14-tolls-of-war:towns.title: Towns
ev:14-tolls-of-war:towns.html:
A tower leans over the town's rooftops at an angle that makes the neighbours nervous. The sign on its door reads: WIZARD. ENCHANTMENTS, IDENTIFICATIONS, MINOR CURSES LIFTED. NO FROGS. The last line looks recent.

Choose one
  • Browse the wares. GO TO the wizard's wares.
  • Offer to help with an experiment. Trial 6 MIND (Lore). If you succeed, GO TO a successful experiment. If you fail, GO TO Experimental Results.
  • Leave before anything else goes wrong. STOP READING.

ev:14-tolls-of-war:up-in-smoke.title: Up in Smoke
ev:14-tolls-of-war:up-in-smoke.html:
The clouds gather into shapes with a great many teeth.

Up in Smoke
Enemies
  • 5x Soot Biter (Quarter)
On Victory
  • 2x random Common Food item, from the cellar of a burned farmstead.
  • 4 exp for each player.
On Defeat
  • 6 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:14-tolls-of-war:woodlands.title: Woodlands
ev:14-tolls-of-war:woodlands.html:
In a hollow among the oaks, a ring of pale mushrooms glows faintly in the dusk. Inside it, a dozen frogs sit perfectly still, watching you. Every so often, one of them blinks out of existence, and back in again, facing a different way.

Choose one
  • Step into the ring. GO TO Fairy Ring.
  • Walk around it. Well around it. STOP READING.

ev:15-the-unicorn:a-coil-rises.html: A coil rises under the raft. GO TO Shipwrecked.

ev:15-the-unicorn:between-the-coils.html: You slip between the coils as they rise, and the serpent never notices you. Everyone gains 2 EXP. GO TO sail on.

ev:15-the-unicorn:chipping-crystals.html: The crystals come loose with a crack, and a puff of yellow. Each player who succeeded gains 6 gold in crystals. Each who failed takes an injury. STOP READING.

ev:15-the-unicorn:deserts.title: Deserts
ev:15-the-unicorn:deserts.html:
At noon, you reach a ruined temple half swallowed by the dunes. Its mirrors, still polished after who knows how many centuries, catch the sun and pour it onto the altar, where a disc of gold burns too bright to look at.

Choose one
  • Kneel, and pray with your eyes open. Trial 9 SOUL (Resolve). If you succeed, GO TO the sun's blessing. If you fail, GO TO the light fills your eyes.
  • (+1 curse) Take the golden disc. GO TO the sun's price.
  • Leave before the light finds you. STOP READING.

ev:15-the-unicorn:kicked-free.html: It kicks free of the net, and of you. You take an injury, and it's gone. STOP READING.

ev:15-the-unicorn:mountains.title: Mountains
ev:15-the-unicorn:mountains.html:
Following a smell of rotten eggs, you find a vent in the mountainside breathing yellow fumes. The rock around it is studded with crystals the colour of embers, and warm to the touch.

Choose one
  • Chip a few from the edge. Each player may hold their breath and take a Trial 5 SOUL (Resolve): GO TO chipping crystals.
  • Climb down into the vent, where the big ones are. Trial 9 SOUL (Resolve). If you succeed, GO TO the big ones. If you fail, GO TO the fumes close over.
  • Leave the mountain its crystals. STOP READING.

ev:15-the-unicorn:nature-s-wrath.title: Nature's Wrath
ev:15-the-unicorn:nature-s-wrath.html:
The eldest raises her staff, and the forest answers. The wolves rise, and behind the stones, something much larger wakes up.

Nature's Wrath
Enemies
  • 3x Dire Wolf (Crescent)
  • 1x Grizzly Bear (Quarter)
On Victory
  • The offerings: 20 gold, 1x random Rare Travel item and 1x random Uncommon Potion.
  • 4 exp for each player.
On Defeat
  • 6 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:15-the-unicorn:nets-and-arrows.title: Nets and Arrows
ev:15-the-unicorn:nets-and-arrows.html:
“That was ours,” says the one in front, and nocks an arrow.

Nets and Arrows
Enemies
  • 3x Poacher (Quarter), the hunters.
  • 1x Ironclad Ranger (Full Moon), their master.
On Victory
  • Longbow (Common Weapon #6) and 6 gold.
  • 4 exp for each player.
On Defeat
  • 6 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:15-the-unicorn:oceans.title: Oceans
ev:15-the-unicorn:oceans.html:
The swell ahead isn't a swell. It's a coil, grey-green and crusted with barnacles, rising and sinking in a long, slow wave. Then another beside it, and another, until the raft is drifting through a maze of serpent.

Choose one
  • (Everyone spends a card) Paddle hard for a gap before it closes. GO TO through the gap.
  • Read the coils, and steer for where the gaps are going to be. Trial 8 MIND (Cunning). If you succeed, GO TO between the coils. If you fail, GO TO a coil rises.

ev:15-the-unicorn:plains.title: Plains
ev:15-the-unicorn:plains.html:
Near the edge of the woods, a white horse is tangled in a hunter's net, thrashing. Then it turns its head, and you see the horn on its brow, spiralled like a seashell and bright as new silver.

Choose one
  • Calm it, and cut it free. Trial 6 SOUL (Influence). If you succeed, GO TO the unicorn's thanks. If you fail, GO TO kicked free.
  • (+2 curse) Wait for the hunters, and sell it to them. GO TO sold to the hunters.
  • (+3 curse) Take the horn. GO TO the horn.
  • Leave it to its fate. STOP READING.

ev:15-the-unicorn:sold-to-the-hunters.html: The hunters are delighted, and a little puzzled: the Shackled aren't usually so reasonable. You gain 40 gold. STOP READING.

ev:15-the-unicorn:the-big-ones.html: You come back up coughing, with your arms full. You gain 20 gold and 1x random Rare Travel item. STOP READING.

ev:15-the-unicorn:the-druids-blessing.html: The eldest lays a hand on your brow, and the forest seems to lean closer. Each player recovers a card. Everyone gains 2 EXP. STOP READING.

ev:15-the-unicorn:the-fence.html:
She sells what's been lost, and buys what's been found, and she doesn't much care which is which.

(+1 curse) Buy stolen goods at half their value:

ItemPrice
2x random Uncommon itemHalf the item's value
1x random Rare itemHalf the item's value

She also buys any item for half its value. STOP READING.

ev:15-the-unicorn:the-fighting-pit.html:
A ring of torches, a crowd of shouting gamblers, and in the middle, a man with a broken nose and a very big grin. The prize is fifteen gold.

The Pit
Enemies
  • 1x Brawler (Quarter), the champion.
Rules
  • Only one player fights. The others watch: they don't play cards, and can't be targeted.
  • Before the fight, each of the others may bet up to 5 gold on the fighter. If the fighter wins, they win their bet back doubled.
On Victory
  • The prize: 15 gold.
  • 4 exp for each player.
On Defeat
  • 6 exp for each player.

After the fight, STOP READING.

ev:15-the-unicorn:the-fire-gutters.html: They turn away, and the fire gutters. STOP READING.

ev:15-the-unicorn:the-fumes-close-over.html: The fumes close over your head. You take 2 injuries. STOP READING.

ev:15-the-unicorn:the-horn.html:
It takes a long time. The unicorn doesn't stop looking at you, not once, not even at the end.

You gain 3x random Rare Potion and 20 gold. STOP READING.

ev:15-the-unicorn:the-light-fills-your-e.html: The light fills your eyes, and keeps filling them. You take an injury. STOP READING.

ev:15-the-unicorn:the-spice-stalls.html:
Saffron, pepper, dried fish, and a cheese that the stallholder warns you not to turn your back on.

ItemPrice
2x random Uncommon Food itemItem value
1x random Rare Food itemItem value

STOP READING.

ev:15-the-unicorn:the-sun-s-blessing.html:
For a moment, you can see everything: every grain of sand, every star behind the sky, and the Shackle on your wrist, glowing like a coal. Then the light passes, and the Shackle feels a little looser.

-1 curse. STOP READING.

ev:15-the-unicorn:the-sun-s-price.html:
The disc is heavy, and hot, and worth a fortune. As you leave the temple, the sun seems to follow you, lower and hotter than it should be.

You gain 40 gold. Search the adventure deck and discard pile for Smoldering Heat, and make it the active weather. STOP READING.

ev:15-the-unicorn:the-unicorn-s-thanks.html:
It stands still for you, trembling, while you cut the last cord. Then it lowers its head and touches the horn to each of your brows in turn, and every ache you've carried today goes out like a candle.

Each player recovers 2 cards. -1 curse.

You're still standing there, dazed, when the hunters come back for their net. GO TO Nets and Arrows.

ev:15-the-unicorn:through-the-gap.html: The coils close behind you with a sound like a sigh. GO TO sail on.

ev:15-the-unicorn:towns.title: Towns
ev:15-the-unicorn:towns.html:
When the sun goes down, lanterns fill the town's lower square and the night market opens: stalls that aren't there by day, run by people you'd never see by daylight.

You may choose up to two options below. Resolve them one at a time, reading each until you reach STOP READING.

Choose up to two
  • Browse the spice stalls. GO TO the spice stalls.
  • Visit the fence, who asks no questions. GO TO the fence.
  • Step into the fighting pit. GO TO the fighting pit.

ev:15-the-unicorn:woodlands.title: Woodlands
ev:15-the-unicorn:woodlands.html:
The path ends at a ring of standing stones, older than the trees around them, with a fire in the middle that doesn't seem to need wood. Robed figures turn to watch you come, and the wolves lying at their feet lift their heads.

Choose one
  • Ask for the druids' blessing. Trial 6 SOUL (Resolve). If you succeed, GO TO the druids' blessing. If you fail, GO TO the fire gutters.
  • (+1 curse) Take the offerings heaped at the foot of the stones. GO TO Nature's Wrath.
  • Back away. STOP READING.

ev:2:a-bribe-for-the-admiralty.html: The officer weighs the purses, finds that your contraband has become remarkably hard to see, and orders the cutter about. GO TO sail on.

ev:2:a-plague-of-frogs.title: A Plague of Frogs
ev:2:a-plague-of-frogs.html:
The frogs regard you with the calm of creatures accustomed to teleporting out of trouble.

A Plague of Frogs
Enemies
  • 4x Warpfrog (Quarter)
On Victory
  • If you carry the Magister's jar, a frog hops into it: you have a frog in a jar.
  • 2x random Common Food item, from the grateful farmer.
  • 3 exp for each player.
On Defeat
  • 5 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:2:deserts.title: Deserts
ev:2:deserts.html:
Riders crest the dune on pale horses, scarves over their faces and swords already drawn. They don't bother shouting demands. Out here, nobody would hear them.

Choose one
  • (Everyone loses half their gold, rounded up) Toss them your purses. They count the coins, and ride off laughing. STOP READING.
  • Draw your weapons. GO TO Sand and Deliver.

ev:2:mountains.title: Mountains
ev:2:mountains.html:
The mine's timbers are black with soot, and so is the snow in front of it. As you pass the entrance, the darkness inside the shaft grins at you. It has a great many teeth.

Choose one
  • Run for it, and don't slip. Trial 4 SOUL (Resolve). If you succeed, you don't look back until the grinning stops. STOP READING. If you fail, GO TO Where There's Smoke.
  • Stand your ground. GO TO Where There's Smoke.

ev:2:oceans.title: Oceans
ev:2:oceans.html:
A cutter flying the royal colours runs down on your raft, and an officer in a plumed helmet leans over the rail. “By order of the Admiralty, the Shackled are barred from these waters. You'll be towed ashore, and your contraband confiscated.” He looks over your belongings. All of them, it seems, are contraband.

Choose one
  • Let them tow you ashore. GO TO towed ashore.
  • (Everyone loses 5 gold) Bribe the officer. GO TO a bribe for the Admiralty.
  • Refuse. GO TO Repel Boarders.

ev:2:pale-figures-rise.html:
You watch in horror as several pale figures rise around you, eyes alight with the dark embers of undeath. As their skeletal bodies take shape, they waste no time readying their rusted weapons.

Choose one
  • (Spend a SOUL card). Cast a prayer to Adrai'lalth, goddess of light and healing. Trial 4 SOUL (Resolve). If you succeed, GO TO successful prayer. If you fail, GO TO failed prayer.

  • Charge at the undead. GO TO Pale Ambush.

ev:2:plains.title: Plains
ev:2:plains.html:
A farmer waves you down from a field crawling with frogs. They cover every furrow, and every few heartbeats one of them vanishes with a soft pop and reappears somewhere worse: in the well, in the bread oven, on the farmer's head.

“The wizard's,” she says, pointing at a tower on the horizon. “He said they'd find their own way home.”

Choose one
  • Help her clear the field. GO TO A Plague of Frogs.
  • Wish her luck, and keep walking. STOP READING.

ev:2:repel-boarders.title: Repel Boarders
ev:2:repel-boarders.html:
The officer sighs, as if you'd spilled something on his deck, and waves his marines over the rail.

Repel Boarders
Enemies
  • 3x Royal Guard (Quarter)
Rules
  • When every Royal Guard is defeated, the cutter gives up and sails away.
On Victory
  • 4 exp for each player.
On Defeat
  • Each player loses an item of common or uncommon rarity.
  • The cutter tows you ashore: move to the nearest land location.
  • 6 exp for each player.

If you won, GO TO sail on. If you lost, GO TO successful landing.

ev:2:sand-and-deliver.title: Sand and Deliver
ev:2:sand-and-deliver.html:
Your attackers fan out to surround you, grinning. They've done this before, and it's never once gone badly for them.

Sand and Deliver
Enemies
  • 4x Bandit (Quarter)
On Victory
  • 6 gold.
  • 1x random Common Weapon.
  • 3 exp for each player.
On Defeat
  • Everyone loses half their gold, rounded up.
  • 5 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:2:towed-ashore.html: The officer's list of contraband turns out to be long, and very flexible. Each player loses an item of common or uncommon rarity, and you move to the nearest land location. GO TO successful landing.

ev:2:towns.title: Towns
ev:2:towns.html:
A drunken mob rolls into the street, kicking down anything that stands upright. You have no way to tell if their mood is fueled by revelry or hatred, but it's doubtlessly a violent one, and it's heading straight at you, leaving you no time to escape.

GO TO Drunken Fight.

ev:2:where-there-s-smoke.title: Where There's Smoke
ev:2:where-there-s-smoke.html:
The soot billows out at you like smoke from a doused fire, and like smoke, it gets into everything: your eyes, your throat, the gaps in your armor. Then it starts to bite.

Where There's Smoke
Enemies
  • 4x Soot Biter (Quarter)
On Victory
  • 10 gold, glinting in the soot they leave behind.
  • 3 exp for each player.
On Defeat
  • 5 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:2:woodlands.title: Woodlands
ev:2:woodlands.html: Mist pools between the trees, and the birds fall silent all at once. Under the moss at your feet, something stirs. GO TO pale figures rise.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:a-harmless-ped.html:
The traveler throws both hands up before you've finished drawing. Under the cowl is an old peddler, who empties a pack onto the ground and backs away from it, trembling.

You gain 8 gold, 2x random Common item and 1x random Uncommon Travel item. STOP READING.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:a-knight-to-re.title: A Knight to Remember
ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:a-knight-to-re.html:
The traveler stands, and wool slides off mail: a knight, travelling plain to avoid exactly this kind of trouble. She draws her sword with a tired sigh, and her squire comes pelting down the hill from his firewood, dragging a shield bigger than he is.

A Knight to Remember
Enemies
  • 1x Ironclad Protector (Quarter), the squire.
  • 1x Ironclad Soldier (Full Moon), the knight.
On Victory
  • 1x random Uncommon Armor, 1x random Uncommon Weapon and 8 gold.
  • 4 exp for each player.
On Defeat
  • 6 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:a-tow.html: The galley tows you as far as its draft allows, then casts you off. Move to an adjacent Ocean sector. GO TO sail on.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:bad-water.title: Bad Water
ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:bad-water.html:
The nomads don't seem surprised. They've met the Shackled before. Their riders wheel their camels round, drawing curved swords, while the women and children lead the string away across the sand.

Bad Water
Enemies
  • 4x Bandit (Quarter), the nomads' riders.
On Victory
  • Sand Nomad Robes (Uncommon Travel #1), 2x random Common Food item, 1x random Uncommon Travel item and 15 gold, from the camels they left behind.
  • 4 exp for each player.
On Defeat
  • 6 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:barter.html:
The traveler unrolls a blanket of odds and ends, and shakes their head when you reach for your purse. “Coin's no use out here. Goods for goods.”

ItemPrice
3x random Common itemAn item of at least its value
1x random Uncommon Travel itemAn item of at least its value

Once you're done trading, GO TO Plains, then choose a different option.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:deserts.title: Deserts
ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:deserts.html:
A string of camels comes out of the heat haze, bells ringing. The water nomads walk beside them, veiled against the sand. Their leader raises an open hand: out here, a greeting is a promise not to steal each other's water.

Choose one
  • Return the greeting, and trade. GO TO the nomads' wares.
  • (+1 curse) Return the greeting, then reach for your weapons. GO TO Bad Water.
  • Keep your distance. The nomads pass without another glance. STOP READING.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:fair-game.title: Fair Game
ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:fair-game.html:
The traveler rolls aside and comes up with a loaded crossbow. A poacher, by the smell of the pelts under the cloak, and a sharp whistle brings a friend out of hiding.

Fair Game
Enemies
  • 2x Poacher (Quarter)
On Victory
  • 2x Beast Meat (Common Food #7), 1x random Common Weapon and 8 gold.
  • 3 exp for each player.
On Defeat
  • 5 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:grave-robbery.title: Grave Robbery
ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:grave-robbery.html:
The traveler rises, unhurried, and the cowl falls back on a skull with two cold embers for eyes. It was never travelling alone: its company rises with it, rusted blades in bony hands. The dead are on the road to the goddess, and they don't take kindly to delays.

Grave Robbery
Enemies
  • 4x Raised Bones (Crescent)
  • 1x Raised Commander (Quarter)
On Victory
  • 1x random Rare Armor, from the Commander's bones, and 10 gold.
  • 8 exp for each player.
On Defeat
  • 12 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:hex-marks-the-.title: Hex Marks the Spot
ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:hex-marks-the-.html:
The traveler doesn't reach for a weapon. They sigh and push back the cowl: an orc woman, older than you expected, with a string of tiny bottles clinking at her throat. She whistles once. Something in the dark whistles back.

Hex Marks the Spot
Enemies
  • 2x Dire Wolf (Crescent)
  • 1x Orc Witch (Full Moon)
On Victory
  • 2x random Common Potion and 1x random Uncommon Potion, from her necklace.
  • 1x random Uncommon Travel item.
  • 4 exp for each player.
On Defeat
  • 6 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:knock-twice.html:
The big door opens. Behind it stands a very large, very old dwarf in a leather apron, holding a hammer the size of a pony. He looks at you for a long moment. Then he closes the door.

You feel you've learned something. Everyone gains 1 EXP. STOP READING.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:mountains.title: Mountains
ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:mountains.html:
Around a bend in the path, a door is set into the mountainside: iron-bound, three times your height, with a much smaller door cut into it at dwarf height. A brass plate reads, in six languages: TRADE ENTRANCE. KNOCK ONCE. DO NOT KNOCK TWICE.

Choose one
  • Knock once. GO TO the trade entrance.
  • Knock twice. GO TO knock twice.
  • Leave. STOP READING.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:oceans.title: Oceans
ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:oceans.html:
A fat merchant galley drifts alongside, oars shipped, and its purser leans over the rail with a ledger. “Water, biscuit, rope, charts. Everything a raft could want. Prices are what they are: you're a long way from the nearest market.”

ItemPrice
2x random Common Food itemTwice the item's value
Compass (Common Travel #3)6 gold
Navigation Charts (Rare Travel #1)30 gold

Once you're done trading:

Choose one
  • (-5 gold) Pay for a tow. GO TO a tow.
  • Ask to come aboard, and work your passage to port. Trial 5 MIND (Influence). If you succeed, GO TO rescued. If you fail, choose a different option.
  • Sail on. GO TO sail on.
  • (+1 curse) Climb aboard and take what you need, without paying. GO TO Rough Trade.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:plains.title: Plains
ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:plains.html:
A lone traveler camps at the edge of the road beside the remains of a meager meal, stoking smoldering embers. Their features lie concealed under a heavy cowl.

Choose one
  • Nod at the stranger and continue on your way. STOP READING.
  • Offer to barter. GO TO barter.
  • Ask about nearby interesting locations. GO TO the traveler's map.
  • Ask about recent news. GO TO the traveler's news.

  • (+1 curse) Shouldn't have camped alone. Pull out your weapons. GO TO rob the traveler.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:rob-the-travel.html:
The traveler watches you draw steel, and doesn't move. Under the cowl, something makes up its mind.

Roll the luck die. If 1-2, GO TO Grave Robbery. If 3-4, GO TO Hex Marks the Spot. If 5-6, GO TO A Knight to Remember. If 7-8, GO TO Fair Game. If 9-10, GO TO a harmless peddler.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:rough-trade.title: Rough Trade
ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:rough-trade.html:
You're over the rail before the purser has finished his sums. The galley's crew, it turns out, are sailors who've been to a few ports rougher than you.

Rough Trade
Enemies
  • 3x Bandit (Quarter), the crew.
  • 1x Ironclad Ranger (Full Moon), the marine on the quarterdeck.
On Victory
  • The purser's stores: 2x random Common Food item, Compass (Common Travel #3), Navigation Charts (Rare Travel #1) and 10 gold.
  • 4 exp for each player.
On Defeat
  • 6 exp for each player.

Win or lose, the galley rows off, and leaves you bobbing in its wake. GO TO sail on.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:smash-and-grab.title: Smash and Grab
ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:smash-and-grab.html:
The dwarf is quicker than you expected, and louder. Before you've reached the first rack, the hall behind the little door is full of mailed dwarves with axes, and none of them are smiling.

Smash and Grab
Enemies
  • 2x Ironclad Protector (Quarter), the hall's guards.
  • 1x Ironclad Soldier (Full Moon), the dwarf, with a very large axe.
On Victory
  • 1x random Rare Weapon and 1x random Rare Armor, from the racks, and 15 gold from the till.
  • 4 exp for each player.
On Defeat
  • 6 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:the-memory-sho.html:
Each memory you sell leaves a small, clean hole behind: the name of a childhood friend, the taste of your mother's bread, what you were doing yesterday morning.

ItemPrice
2x random Uncommon PotionSpend a card
1x random Rare Travel itemSpend 2 cards

Once you're done trading, STOP READING.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:the-nomads-war.html:
ItemPrice
Sand Nomad Robes (Uncommon Travel #1)7 gold
2x random Common Food itemItem value
1x random Uncommon Travel itemItem value

Once you're done trading, you may pay 2 gold to share their water, and the shade of their tents. If you do, you rest now, sheltered, and pay no rest penalty. STOP READING.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:the-trade-entr.html:
The dwarf who answers looks you over, sniffs at the Shackle as if it were a bad smell, then decides your coin smells fine. Behind the little door, racks of steel climb into the dark, every blade stamped with the same rune.

ItemPrice
3x random Common WeaponItem value
2x random Uncommon WeaponItem value
2x random Uncommon ArmorItem value
1x random Rare WeaponItem value
1x random Rare ArmorItem value
Choose one
  • Trade, and go on your way. STOP READING.
  • (+1 curse) Push past the dwarf, and help yourselves. GO TO Smash and Grab.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:the-traveler-s.html:
The traveler draws a map in the ashes with a stick, then taps one spot, twice. “Now there's a place worth the walk.”

Everyone gains 1 EXP, and you hear rumours of one special location on this landmass: turn to its page, and read only its rumour section. GO TO Plains, then choose a different option.

“News?” The traveler laughs, low and hoarse. “Storms in the east. Bandits in the west. Same as every year.” A pause. “And the dead are walking to the goddess. That part's new.”

Look at the top 2 cards of the adventure deck and return them to the top in any order. GO TO Plains, then choose a different option.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:towns.title: Towns
ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:towns.html:
You find yourself wandering around town long after sunset. There's little going on; the few humble stores have closed and most folk have shuttered their windows for the night. This makes it all the more surprising when a girl of no more than ten approaches you with a fearless skip.

"Look at what I found!" she says, proudly holding up what you quickly recognize as an object of great value. Place a random rare Travel item on the table. This is the item held by the child.

Choose one
  • Grab the item from the child's hand. "Fantastic! I've been looking for that". GO TO stole from the unid kid.
  • Ask the child to return it. "That probably belongs to someone. You should hand it over to the garrison." GO TO asked the unid kid to return.
  • Offer the whole item's value in gold, or an item of at least its value. "I could use that. How about we barter?" GO TO fair offer to unid kid.
  • Offer half (rounded up) of the item's value in gold, or an item of at least half (rounded up) its value. "Are you sure you'd not rather have this? Look, it's shiny!" GO TO unfair offer to unid kid.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:woodlands.title: Woodlands
ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:woodlands.html:
Beside the path, a little door is set into the roots of a beech tree, painted blue, with a sign: OPEN (FOR NOW). Behind it, a fae no taller than your hand sits at a counter made from a mushroom cap, selling things far too large to have fit through the door.

“Gold?” it says, wrinkling its nose. “How vulgar. I take memories.”

Choose one
  • Shop. GO TO the memory shop.
  • Back away slowly. STOP READING.

ev:4-horses-woodland-chest-promontory-ta.title: A Warm Welcome
ev:4-horses-woodland-chest-promontory-ta.html:
Spiders the size of your fist pour out of the dunes, each one glowing like a coal from the forge. Somewhere under the sand, something round and pulsing keeps making more.

A Warm Welcome
Enemies
  • 4x Emberskitter Spiderlings (Quarter)
  • 1x Emberskitter Sack (Full Moon)
On Victory
  • 1x random Common Travel item, from the bones of the last traveler.
  • 3 exp for each player.
On Defeat
  • 5 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

You hear the faint friction of steel against steel. A group of half a dozen armored men, perhaps more, hide in disciplined silence by the side of the road.

Their stillness tells you these are no ordinary bandits.

Choose one
  • Sneak around the bandits to ambush them. GO TO ambush the bandits.
  • Charge at the bandits. GO TO charge.
  • Turn around and leave, quietly. STOP READING.

A sound you can't place tugs at the edge of your concentration. You turn your head, listening intently, but can't hear anything of the sort after a minute of intense focus. You shrug and continue moving.

A minute later, you bitterly realize your mistake. This time it's not one sound but many; the unmistakable swish of several swords leaving their scabbards.

GO TO Moonlit Ambush

ev:4-horses-woodland-chest-promontory-ta.title: Deserts
ev:4-horses-woodland-chest-promontory-ta.html:
The sand stays warm long after sunset. Then it gets warmer. Then, all around you, it begins to glow, and to click, and to move.

Choose one
  • Run for the rocks. Trial 5 BODY (Athletics). If you succeed, you reach them with your boots smoking, and the glow loses interest. STOP READING. If you fail, GO TO A Warm Welcome.
  • Stand and fight. GO TO A Warm Welcome.

ev:4-horses-woodland-chest-promontory-ta.title: Mountains
ev:4-horses-woodland-chest-promontory-ta.html:
The snow in the pass is churned with tracks, large and small, all heading the same way you are. Winter has driven the predators down from the peaks. Ahead, something howls, and something bigger answers.

Choose one
  • Stare them down. Trial 6 SOUL (Might). If you succeed, GO TO stared down. If you fail, GO TO Tooth and Claw.
  • (Lose a Food item) Leave them something easier to eat, and slip past. STOP READING.
  • Draw your weapons. GO TO Tooth and Claw.

ev:4-horses-woodland-chest-promontory-ta.title: Oceans
ev:4-horses-woodland-chest-promontory-ta.html: For once, the sea is empty in every direction, which is exactly how you like it. It doesn't last. GO TO pirates.

ev:4-horses-woodland-chest-promontory-ta.title: Plains
ev:4-horses-woodland-chest-promontory-ta.html:
You travel at night, keeping a safe distance from the main roads. The silence is only broken by the rustling of grass and the chirp of an army of crickets, cicadas, the occasional toad, and countless other nightly critters.

Trial 4 MIND (Cunning). If you succeed, GO TO bandits spotted. If you fail, GO TO bandits undetected.
She points at the door, and the farmer helpfully holds it open for you. STOP READING.
The pack decides you're more trouble than you're worth, and melts back into the rocks. Everyone gains 1 EXP. STOP READING.

The shopkeeper's son takes your coin as readily as anyone's, and rather more of it.

ItemPrice
4x random Common itemItem value + 2 gold
2x random Uncommon itemItem value + 2 gold

Once you're done trading, STOP READING.

She sighs, and serves you with the very tips of her fingers.

ItemPrice
6x random Common itemItem value
3x random Uncommon itemItem value

Once you're done trading, STOP READING.
The predators are scared away. STOP READING.

ev:4-horses-woodland-chest-promontory-ta.title: Towns
ev:4-horses-woodland-chest-promontory-ta.html:
You find the general store on the main street. A bell rings as you step in. The shopkeeper looks up, looks at you, and turns the sign in the window to CLOSED without a word. When a farmer comes in behind you, she turns it back.

Choose one
  • Remind her that the Shackle isn't catching. Trial 5 MIND (Influence). If you succeed, GO TO the general store. If you fail, GO TO shown the door.
  • Go round the back, where her son sells what she won't. GO TO the back door.
  • Leave. STOP READING.

ev:4-horses-woodland-chest-promontory-ta.title: Woodlands
ev:4-horses-woodland-chest-promontory-ta.html:
A low, rumbling growl disrupts the quietude of the forest. Bright, fierce pairs of eyes track you from behind the dimly lit underbrush. The hairs on the back of your neck stand up, leaving you with little doubt about the intent of these creatures.

Choose one
  • Run away. Trial 5 BODY. If you succeed, you manage to escape the predators, and STOP READING. If you fail, GO TO Tooth and Claw.
  • (Lose a Food item). Leave behind food as bait and run away. Trial 2 BODY. If you succeed, you manage to escape the predators, and STOP READING. If you fail, GO TO Tooth and Claw.
  • Stand tall and, trying to appear intimidating, let out a roar. Trial 8 BODY + SOUL. If you succeed, GO TO the predators are scared away. If you fail, GO TO Tooth and Claw.
  • Raise your weapon and charge towards the source of the noise. GO TO Tooth and Claw.

ev:5-offering-curio-market:a-handful-of-.html: You're out in the sunlight before your heart remembers to beat. You gain 8 gold and 1x random Rare Travel item. STOP READING.

ev:5-offering-curio-market:circle-the-wa.title: Circle the Wagons
ev:5-offering-curio-market:circle-the-wa.html:
The bandits kick over their stew and grab whatever's closest. The chief doesn't even get up. He just picks another knife.

Circle the Wagons
Enemies
  • 4x Bandit (Crescent)
  • 1x Ringleader (Quarter)
On Victory
  • 6 exp for each player.
On Defeat
  • 9 exp for each player.

If you won, GO TO the takings. If you lost, STOP READING.

ev:5-offering-curio-market:deserts.title: Deserts
ev:5-offering-curio-market:deserts.html:
The wind has uncovered the tip of a pyramid, black stone polished to a mirror by the sand. A doorway gapes just below the surface, and a stair leads down into the cool, dry dark.

Choose one
  • Go down. GO TO the pyramid's stair.
  • Leave the dead their house. STOP READING.

ev:5-offering-curio-market:full-packs.html: The dragon's breathing never changes. Yours doesn't start again until you're a mile down the mountain. You gain 40 gold and 1x random Rare Weapon. STOP READING.

ev:5-offering-curio-market:keeping-the-t.html: You load up what you can carry, and drink a toast to the bandits with their own wine. You gain 15 gold, 1x random Rare Food item (the best of the wine) and 1x random Uncommon Travel item. STOP READING.

ev:5-offering-curio-market:mountains.title: Mountains
ev:5-offering-curio-market:mountains.html:
Smoke curls from a cave high on the slope, in long, slow breaths. You creep up to the mouth and peer in: a hill of gold fills the cave to its ceiling, and on top of it sleeps something vast and red, with one wing folded over its eyes like a blanket.

Choose one
  • Take a handful, and tiptoe out. Trial 5 SOUL (Resolve). If you succeed, GO TO a handful of gold. If you fail, GO TO the dragon stirs.
  • Fill your packs. Trial 9 SOUL (Resolve). If you succeed, GO TO full packs. If you fail, GO TO the dragon stirs.
  • Back away while your nerve holds. STOP READING.

ev:5-offering-curio-market:mummy-dearest.title: Mummy Dearest
ev:5-offering-curio-market:mummy-dearest.html:
The lid grinds aside. The queen sits up in a shower of dust and linen, and all around the chamber, the painted servants step down off the walls.

Mummy Dearest
Enemies
  • 4x Raised Bones (Crescent), her servants.
  • 1x Raised Commander (Quarter), the queen.
On Victory
  • The queen's own: 1x random Rare Armor.
  • The grave goods: 6 gold and 1x random Uncommon Travel item.
  • 6 exp for each player.
On Defeat
  • 9 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:5-offering-curio-market:oceans.title: Oceans
ev:5-offering-curio-market:oceans.html:
A song drifts across the water, sweeter than anything you've ever heard, and your hands have turned the rudder towards it before you've decided to. Ahead, pale shapes are singing on a black reef. The rocks around them are white with bones, and some of the bones are still moving.

Choose one
  • (Everyone spends a card) Stop your ears, and row hard for open water. GO TO rowing for it.
  • Steer by the stars instead of the song. Trial 6 MIND (Lore). If you succeed, GO TO steering clear. If you fail, GO TO the sirens' reef.

ev:5-offering-curio-market:one-of-the-ga.html:
The chief looks you up and down, and laughs. “Shackled! Can't die, can't be hanged. You'll do.” You drink with them, sing their songs, and learn which caravans they mean to hit next. At dawn, you slip away with your share.

You gain 15 gold and 1x random Rare Weapon. +1 curse. STOP READING.

ev:5-offering-curio-market:plains.title: Plains
ev:5-offering-curio-market:plains.html:
A ring of wagons crowns the hill, stolen from half the caravans on the road and chained together into a fort. Inside, around the biggest fire you've seen in weeks, bandits are counting the takings. Their chief throws knives at a merchant painted on a barrel while he waits.

Choose one
  • Walk in and ask to join. “I hear the pay's excellent.” Trial 6 SOUL (Influence). If you succeed, GO TO one of the gang. If you fail, GO TO Circle the Wagons.
  • Attack the camp. GO TO Circle the Wagons.
  • Leave them to it. STOP READING.

ev:5-offering-curio-market:returning-the.html: You leave the wagons where they stand. The villagers will come for what's theirs, and when they do, they'll be telling stories about you instead of the bandits. -1 curse. STOP READING.

ev:5-offering-curio-market:rowing-for-it.html: You row until your palms blister, and the rocks shrink behind you. GO TO sail on.

ev:5-offering-curio-market:steering-clea.html: The song fades behind you, still pleading. GO TO sail on.

ev:5-offering-curio-market:the-dragon-st.html:
A coin slides down the hoard with a sound like a bell in an empty church. The wing lifts, and one golden eye regards you with the mild interest of a cat watching a moth.

“I know that chain,” the dragon says, and its voice fills the cave like smoke. “When you meet whoever holds the other end, tell them I am still waiting.” Then it breathes out, almost gently.

Everyone takes an injury. You flee to an adjacent location. STOP READING.

ev:5-offering-curio-market:the-grave-goo.html: You fill your packs under the queen's stone stare. She doesn't blink. You check, twice. You gain 6 gold and 1x random Uncommon Travel item. STOP READING.

ev:5-offering-curio-market:the-pyramid-s.html:
The stair is trapped, as stairs into pyramids always are. The trick is to use only the steps the last thief didn't.

Everyone takes a Trial 3 BODY (Athletics). Each player who fails takes an injury.

At the bottom lies a burial chamber: painted walls, jars of oil long gone to dust, and grave goods heaped around a sarcophagus carved in the likeness of a queen. Her stone eyes are open.

Choose one
  • Take the grave goods. GO TO the grave goods.
  • Open the sarcophagus. GO TO Mummy Dearest.
  • Leave. STOP READING.

ev:5-offering-curio-market:the-sirens-re.html: The raft grinds onto the reef, and the singers crowd closer, still smiling, still singing. Their teeth are very long. You fight your way back into the water, and it's a long time before you stop hearing the song. GO TO Shipwrecked.

ev:5-offering-curio-market:the-takings.html:
The wagons are stuffed with everything the road has lost this year: bolts of cloth, casks of wine, a harp, a coffin full of spoons.

Choose one
  • Keep it. GO TO keeping the takings.
  • Leave it for the villagers to recover. GO TO returning the takings.

ev:5-offering-curio-market:towns.title: Towns
ev:5-offering-curio-market:towns.html:
The street broadens into a crowded market avenue, abuzz with calls to taste local delicacies, try on the finest—and somehow also cheapest—silks, and engage in a myriad games of skill and chance. You have to stand on your toes to plot your way through the dense crowd. If you don't want to waste the entire day here, you'll have to be deliberate about which business you wade your way towards.

You may choose up to three options from the list below. Resolve them sequentially, reading each of them until you reach the "STOP READING" line.

Choose up to three
  • Make your way to the food stalls. GO TO food shop.
  • Enter the travel equipment store. GO TO travel shop.
  • Check out the weaponsmith's workshop. GO TO weapon shop.
  • Visit the armory. GO TO armory.
  • Visit the alchemist's shop. GO TO potion shop.
  • Enter the pawn shop to rid yourself of some excess weight. GO TO pawn shop.
  • Look around the side streets for unmarked, interesting stores. GO TO interesting stores.
  • Try your luck at a game of chance. GO TO game of chance.

ev:5-offering-curio-market:woodlands.title: Woodlands
ev:5-offering-curio-market:woodlands.html:
The evening sunlight plays tricks on the corner of your eye as it filters through the forest canopy, so you nearly miss a brief golden glint at the edge of your vision. You turn and stand still, squinting to find the shiny object against the backdrop of shifting leaves.

Trial 1 MIND (Cunning). If you succeed, GO TO shiny object. If you fail, continue reading.

You spend a minute scanning your surroundings, but find nothing. You ascribe the glint to a trick of the evening light, and continue on your way. STOP READING.

ev:6-the-last-customer:a-cracking-branch.html: A branch cracks underfoot. Every head turns towards you. GO TO Tooth and Claw.

ev:6-the-last-customer:a-faltering-step.html: Your step falters halfway across, and every skull turns to follow it. GO TO The Old Toll.
