ev:6-the-last-customer:deserts.title: Deserts
ev:6-the-last-customer:deserts.html:
A brass bell rings somewhere beneath your feet. You stop. It rings again, followed by a muffled voice.

“A moment, please. I seem to have misplaced the door.”

Brushing sand from the slope reveals the top of a wooden stall, buried almost to its counter. Behind it, a little clay man strains to lift a shutter. His painted moustache has mostly flaked away, and one ear has been replaced with a drawer handle.

“One customer left,” he says. “Then I may close.” He nods towards a skeleton slumped against the counter, its fingers still curled around a coin. “A patient gentleman. I should hate to disappoint him.”

Choose one
  • Leave the attendant to his business. You have spent enough time waiting in shops. STOP READING.
  • Offer to free the shutter. “Perhaps we can finish his shopping for him.” GO TO free the buried shutter.

ev:6-the-last-customer:mountains.title: Mountains
ev:6-the-last-customer:mountains.html:
A rope bridge spans the ravine. On the far side, a row of skeletons in rusted mail sits beneath a toll board. The painted price has peeled away. As you approach, one raises an empty palm; another points helpfully at a heap of bones below the sign.

Choose one
  • Find another way around. STOP READING.
  • Walk across without breaking stride, as if you had already paid. Trial 5 SOUL (Influence). If you succeed, GO TO waved through. If you fail, GO TO a faltering step.
  • Draw your weapons and cross. GO TO The Old Toll.

ev:6-the-last-customer:oceans.title: Oceans
ev:6-the-last-customer:oceans.html:
A cluster of wooden coffins drifts across your course. Each bears a little wreath of salt-stiffened flowers. You reach for something to push them clear, then pause. Against the slap of the waves, you think you hear knocking.

Trial 4 MIND (Cunning). If you succeed, you notice the bony fingers hooked over the lids in time to steer clear. The knocking follows you for a while. GO TO sail on. If you fail, GO TO Dead Reckoning.

ev:6-the-last-customer:plains.title: Plains
ev:6-the-last-customer:plains.html:
Squinting against the evening sun, you spot a plume of smoke billowing near the horizon. As you approach cautiously, the faint sounds of conversation tell you of a trading caravan drafting guard duties for the night.

Choose one
  • Approach the traders openly: GO TO Approaching the Traders.
  • Wait until dusk and sneak past the guards, to steal the merchant's wares: GO TO Lightened Purses.
  • Turn around and leave: STOP READING.

ev:6-the-last-customer:towns.title: Towns
ev:6-the-last-customer:towns.html:
Bunting stretches across the square. Beneath it, a tired official scratches a previous winner's name off a little wooden plaque. He notices you watching and brightens.

“New contestants! Splendid. The locals have become rather difficult to impress.”

Choose one
  • Walk on before he announces your names. STOP READING.
  • Enter the contest. If this town is adjacent to Mountains, GO TO the stone lifting contest. Otherwise, GO TO the pepper eating contest.

links.clause: If this town is adjacent to Mountains

ev:6-the-last-customer:waved-through.html: The captain lowers its palm and waves you through. Somewhere under the rust, a bookkeeper is satisfied. Everyone gains 2 EXP. STOP READING.

ev:6-the-last-customer:woodlands.title: Woodlands
ev:6-the-last-customer:woodlands.html:
A torn pack hangs from a low branch. Beneath it, a bear noses through scattered provisions while wolves wait at a respectful distance. Something useful still bulges inside the canvas, just beyond the bear's reach. Yours, too, unless you leave the cover of the trees.

Choose one
  • Leave the animals to their meal. STOP READING.
  • Creep towards the pack. Trial 5 BODY (Cunning). If you succeed, GO TO recover the torn pack. If you fail, GO TO a cracking branch.

ev:61-lay-of-the-land:deserts.title: Deserts
ev:61-lay-of-the-land:deserts.html:
The sand forgives nothing. The days burn, the nights freeze, and the dunes move when you aren't looking.

Choose one
  • Look for shade in a dry riverbed. Trial 6 BODY (Athletics). If you succeed, everyone may rest sheltered. If you fail, exhaustion causes you to take an injury. STOP READING.
  • Pray to Adrai'lalth over the sacred sands. Trial 6 SOUL (Resolve). If you succeed, everyone recovers a spent card. If you fail, +1 curse. STOP READING.
  • Follow the stars. Trial 6 MIND (Lore). If you succeed, move to an adjacent location along a road. If you fail, move to a random adjacent location. STOP READING.
  • (If you have an ocean or river nearby) Head for the water. GO TO Setting Sail.
  • Walk on. STOP READING.

links.clause: If you have an ocean or river nearby) Head for the water

ev:61-lay-of-the-land:lay-of-the-land.title: Lay of the Land
ev:61-lay-of-the-land:lay-of-the-land.html:
Every land has its ways, and those who travel it long enough learn them.

Read the section for your current terrain.

ev:61-lay-of-the-land:mountains.title: Mountains
ev:61-lay-of-the-land:mountains.html:
The peaks don't care that you came. Every step up is paid for in breath, and the mountain answers with its own: the hissing whisper of its ancient, volcanic blood.

Choose one
  • Bathe in the hot springs. Trial 5 SOUL (Resolve). If you succeed, recover a spent card. STOP READING.
  • (Spend a card) Climb to the ridge. Everyone gains 2 EXP. STOP READING.
  • (If you have an ocean or river nearby) Head for the water. GO TO Setting Sail.
  • Walk on. STOP READING.

links.clause: If you have an ocean or river nearby) Head for the water

ev:61-lay-of-the-land:plains.title: Plains
ev:61-lay-of-the-land:plains.html:
Grass runs to the edge of the world, and the wind combs it in long silver waves. There's nothing to hide behind out here, and nothing that needs to.

Choose one
  • Forage along the hedgerows. You gain Fruit (Common Food #2). STOP READING.
  • Stop, and take in the view. Everyone gains 1 EXP. STOP READING.
  • (If you have an ocean or river nearby) Head for the water. GO TO Setting Sail.
  • Walk on. STOP READING.

links.clause: If you have an ocean or river nearby) Head for the water

ev:61-lay-of-the-land:woodlands.title: Woodlands
ev:61-lay-of-the-land:woodlands.html:
The trees close overhead, and the light turns green and patient. The wood gives freely, to those who know where to look.

Choose one
  • Gather roots and mushrooms. You gain Bundle of Vegetables (Common Food #4). STOP READING.
  • Climb to the treetops. Trial 5 BODY (Athletics). If you succeed, look at the top two cards of the adventure deck and move any number of them to the bottom. STOP READING.
  • (If you have an ocean or river nearby) Head for the water. GO TO Setting Sail.
  • Walk on. STOP READING.

links.clause: If you have an ocean or river nearby) Head for the water

ev:62-town-and-country:deserts.title: Deserts
ev:62-town-and-country:deserts.html:
This is a caravanserai around a deep well, walled against the sand. Camels kneel in the courtyard, and stalls under striped awnings sell the essentials for surviving in the desert.

You may buyPrice
Sturdy Tent (Common Travel #1)2 gold
Compass (Common Travel #3)3 gold
Sand Nomad Robes (Uncommon Travel #1)7 gold

Out here, gold is worth its weight in water. You can sell Waterskin and Fruit at five times its value.

Choose one
  • Browse the bazaar of the far roads. GO TO Bazaar of the Far Roads.
  • Sit with the nomad elders. GO TO the nomad elders.
  • Share your travel stories. Trial 6 MIND (Influence). If you succeed, GO TO a story worth paying for. If you fail, GO TO a story nobody believes.
  • Leave. STOP READING.

ev:62-town-and-country:mountains.title: Mountains
ev:62-town-and-country:mountains.html:
This is a quarry town, grey with stone dust. Carts of rock rumble down from the heights all day, and the smiths rework whatever steel comes their way.

You may buyPrice
Climbing Rope (Common Travel #5)1 gold
Fur Pelt (Common Travel #6)6 gold
Journeyman's Belt (Common Travel #2)1 gold

You may sell any Armor item to the smiths at its full value.

Choose one
  • (Spend a card) Work a shift at the quarries. Trial 6 SOUL (Resolve). GO TO a shift at the quarries.
  • Drink with the miners. GO TO drink with the miners.
  • Leave. STOP READING.

ev:62-town-and-country:oceans.title: Oceans
ev:62-town-and-country:oceans.html:
This is a harbour town, all salt and tar. Nets dry on every wall, and the catch is sold before it stops moving.

You may buyPrice
Platefin (Common Food #1)2 gold
Horned Salmon (Uncommon Food #2)4 gold
Shimmerscale (Uncommon Food #5)5 gold

You may sell any Travel item to the sailors, at its full value.

Choose one
  • Visit the chandler. GO TO The Chandler.
  • (If this town has a landing) Hire a ship. GO TO the harbour.
  • Drink with the sailors. GO TO drink with the sailors.
  • Leave. STOP READING.

links.clause: If this town has a landing) Hire a ship

ev:62-town-and-country:plains.title: Plains
ev:62-town-and-country:plains.html:
This is a market town at a crossroads, ringed by fields. Carts creak in from every farm around, heavy with the harvest, and the farmers shout their prices over each other.

You may buyPrice
Tough Jerky (Common Food #5)2 gold
Eggs (Common Food #3)2 gold
Bundle of Vegetables (Common Food #4)2 gold
Fruit (Common Food #2)1 gold

You may sell any Food item to the market at its full value.

Choose one
  • (Spend a card) Help with the harvest. GO TO help with the harvest.
  • Drink with the drovers. GO TO drink with the drovers.
  • Leave. STOP READING.

ev:62-town-and-country:town-and-country.title: Town and Country
ev:62-town-and-country:town-and-country.html:
No two towns are alike. Farmers, woodcutters, miners, nomads and fishers: every town lives off the land around it.

Read the section for any one terrain adjacent to this town. If the town stands on a river, you may go down to the river quay instead: GO TO the river quay.

links.clause: If the town stands on a river

ev:62-town-and-country:woodlands.title: Woodlands
ev:62-town-and-country:woodlands.html:
This is a town of timber and sawdust at the edge of the trees. Axes ring from dawn to dusk, and at night, the hunters keep watch for what comes out of the woods.

You may buyPrice
Fur Pelt (Common Travel #6)6 gold
Outrider's Whistle (Uncommon Travel #3)5 gold
Fishing Pole (Uncommon Travel #6)7 gold
Longbow (Common Weapon #6)3 gold
Hunting Knife (Common Weapon #5)1 gold

You may sell any Weapon to the hunters at its full value.

Choose one
  • Visit the woodcarvers. GO TO The Woodcarvers.
  • (Spend a card) Work the timber. Trial 6 BODY (Might). GO TO work the timber.
  • Listen to the woodsmen's tales. GO TO woodsmen's tales.
  • Leave. STOP READING.

ev:63-temple-of-fire:after-the-bath.html:
The hall feels chilly on your scalded skin. Those who built this bath were a proud race of warriors, and you know with certainty that they are gone.

You gain 3 EXP for each injury you took in the bath. With 3 or more, you may take a scorched iron collar from the bathers' offerings: gain Berserker's Collar (Unique Armor #4). With 4 or more, gold-veined black marble spreads over your arms, like the sleeves of the bathers on the walls: gain Flametouched Tattoos (Unique Armor #5). STOP READING.

ev:63-temple-of-fire:temple-of-fire.title: Temple of Fire
ev:63-temple-of-fire:temple-of-fire.html:
Rumours

Miners speak of a temple floating over a sleeping volcano, moored to the crater by bridges of black stone. Those who drink from its bowl come back harder than rock, if they come back at all.

Two mountain ridges run side by side, jagged teeth scraping the sky like the jaws of a buried leviathan, and open onto a caldera carved by forces so vast they border on the divine. Magma pulses white-hot under its crust. Above its centre floats a somber marble temple, glowing with the same lazy pulses, moored to the crater's edge by dozens of basalt bridges.

The heat on the bridge is near unbearable. At its end, a basalt door twice the height of a man stands half open under an inscription. You can't read the script, but the Shackle stirs and understands it for you: the temple is to be entered alone.

If you already freed the Witness of Fire, GO TO the cold temple.

Choose one
  • (Each player without the mark of fire, once per day) Slip through the door alone. GO TO the bowl.
  • (Everyone with the mark of fire) Enter together. GO TO the baths.
  • Turn back. STOP READING.

links.clause: If you already freed the Witness of Fire

ev:63-temple-of-fire:the-bath.html:
You lower yourself into the magma, biting back a scream. Were it not for the Shackle, you'd melt on the spot. Then the pain turns numb, and memories that aren't yours rise with the heat: the ring of forges, rage, pride.

Stay in as long as you dare. Each time, take an injury, then a Trial 10 BODY + SOUL (Resolve). Climb out when you fail, or whenever you choose to. Then GO TO after the bath.

ev:63-temple-of-fire:the-baths.html:
The bowl is gone, and so is the carving of the drinking man. In their place, a passage leads through the hot rock to a hall like a bath house: pools of magma between marble screens carved with men and women bathing in liquid stone. Beyond them, filling half the hall, a salamander of dark rock lies coiled in sleep, its scales pulsing a faint red. It isn't only a statue.

Choose one
  • (Each player, once per day) Step into a pool. GO TO the bath.
  • Meditate before the salamander. GO TO the salamander.
  • (Unless you already struck the salamander) Strike its head with all your strength. GO TO the strike.
  • (Unless you already read the reliefs at this location) Study the reliefs. Trial 12 SOUL + MIND (Lore). If you succeed, GO TO the reliefs. If you fail, GO TO the carvings keep their secrets.
  • Leave the temple. STOP READING.

ev:63-temple-of-fire:the-bowl.html:
The door grinds shut behind you. As your eyes adjust, the dark becomes a round chamber with a single feature: a marble bowl brimming with molten rock, lighting reliefs of ancient figures in the middle of some ritual.

Choose one
  • Lift the bowl to your lips. If it worked for the figures on the walls, it should work for an unfortunate immortal like you. GO TO the drink.
  • Push the door open again, and leave. Trial 10 BODY (Might). If you succeed, you force your way back out into the heat. STOP READING. If you fail, choose a different option.

links.clause: If it worked for the figures on the walls

ev:63-temple-of-fire:the-drink.html:
Your palms sizzle on the bowl, and the Shackle rebuilds them as fast as they burn. At the first sip, your whole body bursts into flame.

You take an injury. Then take a Trial 8 SOUL (Resolve). If you succeed, GO TO the mark. If you fail, your arms give out and the bowl clatters back onto its plinth. From the walls comes a feeling you can't mistake: scorn. The door slides open. STOP READING.

ev:63-temple-of-fire:the-mark.html:
You close your mind to the agony and drain the bowl. Your insides burn away and rebuild into something as hard as volcanic rock, and the pain turns into a euphoria so fierce that a roar tears out of you. When you touch your tongue, it feels like polished marble.

Spend all of your cards. You gain 5 EXP. You now bear the mark of fire. The door swings open. The temple will welcome you back, but now it's time to rest. STOP READING.

ev:63-temple-of-fire:the-strike.html:
The rock doesn't crack. It rings like a bell in an empty cathedral, long after it should have stopped, and deep inside the stone something vast flinches. Far away, other bells ring in answer.

You take an injury. Everyone gains 4 EXP. You struck the salamander. STOP READING.

ev:64-emberskitter-nest:emberskitter-nes.title: Emberskitter Nest
ev:64-emberskitter-nest:emberskitter-nes.html:
Rumours

Caravans give a wide berth to a stretch of dunes where the sand clicks at night, and glows. The few who went to look came back without their eyebrows. Something down there sleeps on a bed of gold, they say, and its children are sparks.

You smell it before you see it: hot glass and sulphur, on a wind that should be cold at this hour. Past the next dune, the sand slopes down into a crater riddled with burrows, each one rimmed with glass where the sand has melted. From inside them comes a clicking, like a thousand tongues against a thousand teeth.

If you already killed the Matriarch at this location, GO TO the cold nest.

Choose one
  • (Once per day) Chip the glass from the rims of the burrows. GO TO the rims.
  • Go down into the tunnels. GO TO the tunnels.
  • (If you already cleared the tunnels at this location) Follow the heat down to the brood chamber. GO TO the brood chamber.
  • (If you already burned the brood at this location) Go down to where the heat comes from. GO TO the Matriarch.
  • Leave. STOP READING.

links.clause: If you already killed the Matriarch at this location
If you already cleared the tunnels at this location) Follow the heat down to the brood chamber
If you already burned the brood at this location) Go down to where the heat comes from

ev:64-emberskitter-nest:the-brood-chambe.html:
The tunnel opens into a cavern studded with egg sacs the size of barrels, each pulsing like a coal someone forgot to put out. Some are already splitting.

Burn the Brood
Enemies
  • 2x Emberskitter Sack (Quarter)
  • 3x Emberskitter Spiderlings (Crescent), hatching.
On Victory
  • You burned the brood.
  • 1x random Rare Armor, from the last party that tried.
  • 6 exp for each player.
On Defeat
  • 9 exp for each player.

If you won, the deepest tunnel breathes out heat like a forge. Something in it, something vast, clicks once, and waits. STOP READING.

ev:64-emberskitter-nest:the-matriarch.html:
The last tunnel ends in a hollow of black glass, hot as an oven. She lies coiled on a hoard of coins fused into one glittering slab: a spider the size of a wagon, her silk running molten from her spinnerets. Sparks crawl over her back, and every one of them has legs.

Brood Mother
Enemies
  • 1x Emberskitter Matriarch (Full Moon)
  • 1x Emberskitter Sack (Quarter)
  • 3x Emberskitter Spiderlings (Crescent)
On Victory
  • You killed the Matriarch.
  • Her hoard: 20 gold, and Roadscorch (Unique Armor #2), boots still warm from her silk.
  • 8 exp for each player.
On Defeat
  • 12 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:64-emberskitter-nest:the-rims.html:
The glass comes away in curls, amber and black, and the clicking below stops, as if something is listening.

Roll the luck die. If 1-3, sparks boil out of the nearest burrow and chase you up the dune: everyone takes an injury. STOP READING. If 4-10, you gain 4 gold in glass. STOP READING.

ev:64-emberskitter-nest:the-tunnels.html:
The burrows join into tunnels lined with glass that glows faintly from within. It gets hotter with every step, and the clicking comes from everywhere at once. Then the walls start to move.

Kindling
Enemies
  • 5x Emberskitter Spiderlings (Quarter)
On Victory
  • You cleared the tunnels.
  • 6 gold, in glass beads.
  • 5 exp for each player.
On Defeat
  • 8 exp for each player.

If you won, the way down lies open, and from below comes a slow pulse, like a heart made of coals. STOP READING.

ev:65-bone-weaver-s-barrow:bone-weaver-s.title: Bone Weaver's Barrow
ev:65-bone-weaver-s-barrow:bone-weaver-s.html:
Rumours

Shepherds won't graze near the old king's barrow any more. At night the grass around it is pressed flat in wide circles, as if something heavy walked there until dawn, and the king's champion has been seen at its door, still keeping watch in his rusted mail.

The barrow rises out of the grass like the shoulder of a sleeping giant, ringed by standing stones. The grass around it lies pressed flat in wide, patient circles. The slab over its door, carved with a crowned king, has been rolled aside. From the inside.

If you already destroyed the Weaver, GO TO the quiet barrow.

Choose one
  • Go down into the barrow. GO TO the halls of the dead.
  • (If you already quieted the halls at this location) Go on to the champion's hall. GO TO the champion.
  • (If you already passed the champion) Go down to the king's tomb. GO TO the king's tomb.
  • Leave. STOP READING.

links.clause: If you already destroyed the Weaver
If you already quieted the halls at this location) Go on to the champion's hall
If you already passed the champion) Go down to the king's tomb

ev:65-bone-weaver-s-barrow:duty-unto-dea.title: Duty Unto Death
ev:65-bone-weaver-s-barrow:duty-unto-dea.html:
He raises the sword, and the bones in the niches raise theirs.

Duty Unto Death
Enemies
  • 1x Raised Commander (Quarter), the champion.
  • 4x Raised Bones (Crescent)
On Victory
  • You passed the champion. His armour falls empty.
  • 6 exp for each player.
On Defeat
  • 9 exp for each player.

If you won, the door to the tomb stands open. The air beyond it is so cold it burns. STOP READING.

ev:65-bone-weaver-s-barrow:the-champion.html:
A warrior in rusted mail stands before the door to the tomb, leaning on a greatsword. Blue light burns in his eye sockets, but his jaw works as if he's trying to speak. The necromancer's leash is on him too.

Choose one
  • Remind him of the oath he swore his king. Trial 10 SOUL (Influence). If you succeed, GO TO the champion steps aside. If you fail, GO TO Duty Unto Death.
  • Fight him. GO TO Duty Unto Death.
  • Back away. STOP READING.

ev:65-bone-weaver-s-barrow:the-halls-of-.html:
Niches line the halls, one for every warrior who followed the king into the dark. They're all empty. The bones are standing in the middle of the hall, waiting, and they all turn to face you at once.

The Honour Guard
Enemies
  • 6x Raised Bones (Quarter)
On Victory
  • You quieted the halls.
  • 1x random Uncommon Armor, from the niches.
  • 5 exp for each player.
On Defeat
  • 8 exp for each player.

If you won, a light burns deeper in the barrow, cold and blue, and something in armour paces before it. STOP READING.

ev:65-bone-weaver-s-barrow:the-king-s-to.html:
The king lies on his bier. Something else sits on his throne: a thing of bones knotted together with threads of bone, stitching a new servant out of the old king's ribs, and humming. It stops humming when it sees you.

The Bone Weaver
Enemies
  • 1x Weaver of Bone (Full Moon)
  • 4x Raised Bones (Crescent), summoned by the Weaver.
On Victory
  • You destroyed the Weaver. -1 curse, for the dead laid to rest.
  • The Weaver's grimoire: Dodecanomicon (Unique Weapon #1).
  • 8 exp for each player.
On Defeat
  • 12 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:66-the-crooked-spire:a-door.html:
He rummages in a cupboard full of doors, all leaning against each other, and picks one out by its knocker. “This one goes everywhere. Mostly.”

Roll the luck die. If 1-2, it goes mostly: move to a random adjacent location. STOP READING. If 3-10, you and your allies may move to any special location on the map. STOP READING.

ev:66-the-crooked-spire:a-fortune-in-the.html: He squints into the steam of his tea. Look at the top 5 cards of the adventure deck and return them to the top in any order. STOP READING.

ev:66-the-crooked-spire:tea-with-the-mag.html: He has been everywhere, and remembers most of it. Everyone gains 1 EXP. Choose any special location on the map, and read its rumours. STOP READING.

ev:66-the-crooked-spire:the-crooked-spir.title: The Crooked Spire
ev:66-the-crooked-spire:the-crooked-spir.html:
Rumours

There's a tower that leans at an angle no builder would allow, and never falls. Its master is older than the kingdom, they say, and will do almost anything for a good curiosity: open a door to the far side of the world, or make it rain in the desert. Don't mention frogs.

The tower leans over the road at an angle that makes your neck ache in sympathy. Its door opens before you can knock. “Visitors!” cries a thin old man in a dressing gown embroidered with stars. He peers at your wrists. “Shackled visitors! Marvellous. Nothing interesting has happened here since the frogs.” He introduces himself as Magister Crane, and puts the kettle on.

Choose one
  • (10 gold) Ask for a door. GO TO a door.
  • (5 gold) Order some weather. GO TO weather to order.
  • (3 gold) Have your fortune read in the steam of his tea. GO TO a fortune in the steam.
  • (Once per day) Keep him company over tea. GO TO tea with the Magister.
  • (Once per day) Volunteer for one of his experiments. GO TO the experiment.
  • Ask whether there's anything he needs. GO TO the Magister's wants.
  • (Unless you already asked about the Shackle at this location) Ask whether he can lift your Shackle. GO TO the Shackle.
  • Leave. STOP READING.

ev:66-the-crooked-spire:the-experiment.html:
He sits you in a copper chair, hums a little tune, and pulls a lever. Roll the luck die:

RollWhat happens to you
1-2You spend the rest of the day as a frog. Spend all of your cards.
3-5Your hair turns blue, and stays that way. You gain 3 EXP.
6-8For an hour, you can hear colours. You gain 5 EXP.
9“Fascinating,” he says, and pays you for your trouble. You gain 1x random Rare Potion.
10You blink, and you're standing a step to the left. You blink again, and you're not. “Fascinating,” he says, and fetches a pair of boots from under his bed, still muddy from places that aren't on any map. You gain Boots of Displacement (Unique Travel #2).

STOP READING.

ev:66-the-crooked-spire:the-frog-returns.html:
The Magister holds the jar up to the light. The frog blinks out of it, and back in, facing the other way. He wipes his eyes. “Forty years,” he says. Then he opens his cabinet of curiosities, and tells you to take your pick.

You gain 2x random Rare item. Everyone gains 8 EXP. Cross out the Magister's jar and a frog in a jar: you returned his frog. STOP READING.

ev:66-the-crooked-spire:the-frogs.html:
“My frogs,” he says, and his face falls. “A little experiment in being elsewhere. They got out forty years ago, and they've been blinking all over the world ever since. Bring one back, and I'll make it worth your while.” He hands you a jar with holes in the lid.

You now carry the Magister's jar. They like fairy rings, he adds, and wet weather. And farms. STOP READING.

ev:66-the-crooked-spire:the-magister-s-w.html:
“Curiosities,” he says, rubbing his hands. “Anything I haven't seen. Which, at my age, is very little.”

Choose one
  • (Lose a Giant Egg) Show him the egg. GO TO a giant egg.
  • (Lose a Tinker's Kit) Show him the kit. GO TO for the orrery.
  • (Lose a Moon Eel) Show him the eel. GO TO a moon eel.
  • (If you already read the reliefs in the Temple of Fire, unless you already told the Magister of the war) Tell him what the reliefs in the Temple of Fire showed. GO TO ice and chains.
  • (Unless you already returned his frog) Ask what he needs most. GO TO the frogs.
  • (With a frog in a jar) Bring him back his frog. GO TO the frog returns.

links.clause: If you already read the reliefs in the Temple of Fire

ev:66-the-crooked-spire:the-shackle.html:
He turns your wrist to the light, and for once he says nothing clever. “Oh, I could break the chain,” he says at last. “Chains are easy. It's whatever is holding the other end I'd worry about.” He lets go, and won't speak of it again.

Everyone gains 3 EXP. You asked about the Shackle. STOP READING.

ev:66-the-crooked-spire:weather-to-order.html: He opens a window and shouts at the sky. Search the adventure deck and discard pile for any Weather card, and make it the active weather. STOP READING.

ev:67-deepforge:an-endless-saga.html: The saga goes on for hours, in a dialect you don't know. Everyone gains 2 EXP. STOP READING.

ev:67-deepforge:deepforge.title: Deepforge
ev:67-deepforge:deepforge.html:
Rumours

Deep in the mountain, the dwarves keep a city of a hundred forges, and they keep it shut. On market days, they say, even the Shackled may trade there, if they mind their manners and don't mind paying extra.

A stair cut into the mountainside climbs to a pair of bronze doors, each tall enough for a giant, and scarred by one. Guards in full plate watch from the gatehouse, and one of them spits when he sees the Shackle. Behind the doors, the whole mountain hums with hammers.

If you already rekindled the Old Forge, the gate stands open to you. Otherwise, roll the luck die. If 1-2, GO TO no market today. If 3-10, it's market day, and the guards let you in.

Choose one
  • Visit the Great Forge. GO TO the Great Forge.
  • Browse the Deep Market. GO TO the Deep Market.
  • (Once per day) Sit at the skald's feet in the Hall of Ancestors. Trial 6 MIND (Lore). If you succeed, GO TO the saga of the Old Forge. If you fail, GO TO an endless saga.
  • Drink in the Brewhall. GO TO the Brewhall.
  • (Unless you already carry the Council's torch or already rekindled the Old Forge) Petition the Council of Clans. GO TO the Council of Clans.
  • (With the Council's torch) Take the deep road. GO TO the deep road.
  • (With the Council's torch, if you already cleared the deep road at this location) Rekindle the Old Forge. GO TO the Old Forge.
  • Leave. STOP READING.

links.clause: if you already cleared the deep road at this location) Rekindle the Old Forge

ev:67-deepforge:dwarven-beds.html: The beds are short, but the stone keeps the cold out. If you rest before leaving Deepforge, you rest sheltered, and your first action next day is free. STOP READING.

ev:67-deepforge:no-market-today.html: The gate stays shut. “Market day's tomorrow,” says the guard. “Or the day after. Or never, for your sort.” STOP READING.

ev:67-deepforge:still-standing.html: The champion slides gently under the table, and the Brewhall roars. You gain 10 gold. Everyone gains 3 EXP. STOP READING.

ev:67-deepforge:the-brewhall.html:
Long tables, longer beards, and ale served in horns the size of your arm. The dwarves here are friendlier, or at least drunker.

Choose one
  • (2 gold for each player) Take beds for the night. GO TO dwarven beds.
  • Challenge their champion to a drinking contest. Trial 8 BODY (Might). If you succeed, GO TO still standing. If you fail, GO TO under the table.
  • Leave. STOP READING.

ev:67-deepforge:the-council-of-clans.html:
Seven clan lords sit around a table of black stone, and all seven stop talking when you walk in. The eldest hears you out, then lays an unlit torch on the table. “Carry this down the deep road, and light it in the Old Forge. Nobody who went down that road in my grandfather's time came back up it. Do it, and every door in Deepforge is yours.”

You now carry the Council's torch. STOP READING.

ev:67-deepforge:the-deep-market.html:
Stalls line a street of carved stone that runs deeper into the mountain than you care to follow: mushroom bread, cave eel, and lamp oil by the barrel.

ItemPrice
2x random Uncommon Food itemItem value
2x random Common Travel itemItem value
Prospector's Pick (Common Travel #9)Item value

Once you're done trading, STOP READING.

ev:67-deepforge:the-great-forge.html:
A cavern of anvils, lit by rivers of molten iron. The smiths work in silence, and name their prices without looking up.

ItemPrice
1x random Rare WeaponItem value + 5 gold
1x random Rare ArmorItem value + 5 gold
1x random Uncommon WeaponItem value
2x random Uncommon ArmorItem value

If you already rekindled the Old Forge, every item costs only its value. Once you're done trading, STOP READING.

ev:67-deepforge:the-saga-of-the-old-forg.html: The skald sings of the Old Forge, the first fire of the dwarves, lost to the smoke in the deep roads so long ago that only the song remembers the way. The clans swore to rekindle it. None of them have. Everyone gains 5 EXP. STOP READING.

ev:67-deepforge:under-the-table.html: You wake at dawn under the table, with a dwarf's boot for a pillow. Spend 2 cards. STOP READING.

ev:68-houndmaster-s-lodge:hounded.title: Hounded
ev:68-houndmaster-s-lodge:hounded.html:
The hunters come out of the dark with their bows drawn, and the hounds come with them. As far as the lodge is concerned, you stole from the lodge.

Hounded
Enemies
  • 3x Poacher (Quarter), the hunters.
  • 2x Dire Wolf (Crescent), their hounds.
On Victory
  • 4 exp for each player.
On Defeat
  • 6 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:68-houndmaster-s-lodge:houndmaster-s-.title: Houndmaster's Lodge
ev:68-houndmaster-s-lodge:houndmaster-s-.html:
Rumours

Deep in the woods, hunters raise hounds the size of ponies. A hound chooses its master there, they say, not the other way round, and the lodge will take in anyone who can keep up with the pack, Shackled or not.

You hear the lodge long before you see it: a hundred hounds baying at once, then silence at a single whistle. It's a longhouse of black timber, its door carved with running dogs. The hunters sitting outside look up as you come, and so do the hounds at their feet, each one the size of a pony.

If you already stole from the lodge, GO TO Hounded.

Choose one
  • (Each player, once per day) Run with the pack. Trial 7 BODY (Athletics). If you succeed, GO TO keeping up. If you fail, GO TO left behind.
  • Trade with the hunters. GO TO the hunters' stores.
  • (Once per day) Join the wolf hunt. GO TO the wolf hunt.
  • (Once per day, if you already hunted the wolves at this location) Join the bear hunt. GO TO the bear hunt.
  • (If you already hunted the bears at this location, unless you already killed the Old Grizzly) Hunt the Old Grizzly. GO TO the Old Grizzly.
  • (+1 curse) Come back at night, and steal a pup from the kennels. Trial 8 BODY (Cunning). If you succeed, GO TO a stolen pup. If you fail, GO TO Hounded.
  • Leave. STOP READING.

links.clause: If you already stole from the lodge
if you already hunted the wolves at this location) Join the bear hunt
If you already hunted the bears at this location

ev:68-houndmaster-s-lodge:keeping-up.html: The pack runs you ragged through the woods. By the end, the hounds are looking at you differently. You gain 5 EXP. STOP READING.

ev:68-houndmaster-s-lodge:left-behind.html: You come back hours after the pack, to a lot of wagging tails and one or two knowing smiles. You gain 2 EXP. STOP READING.

ev:68-houndmaster-s-lodge:the-bear-hunt.html:
Two bears have been raiding the lodge's smokehouse. The hounds refuse to go in after them, which tells you something.

The Bear Hunt
Enemies
  • 2x Grizzly Bear (Quarter)
On Victory
  • You hunted the bears.
  • Superior Beast Meat (Uncommon Food #4).
  • 6 exp for each player.
On Defeat
  • 9 exp for each player.

If you won, the huntmaster finally tells you about the Old Grizzly: the bear that killed the last houndmaster, and the one before him. STOP READING.

ev:68-houndmaster-s-lodge:the-hunters-st.html:
Smoked meat hangs from every rafter, and bows, snares and snowshoes from every wall.

ItemPrice
2x Beast Meat (Common Food #7)Value
Superior Beast Meat (Uncommon Food #4)Value
Longbow (Common Weapon #6)Value
1x random Uncommon Travel itemValue

Once you're done trading, STOP READING.

ev:68-houndmaster-s-lodge:the-wolf-hunt.html:
The huntmaster, a grey woman with a scar where her smile should be, takes you after the wolves that have been taking the lodge's sheep. The hounds find them before noon.

The Wolf Hunt
Enemies
  • 4x Dire Wolf (Quarter)
On Victory
  • You hunted the wolves.
  • 2x Beast Meat (Common Food #7).
  • 5 exp for each player.
On Defeat
  • 8 exp for each player.

If you won, the huntmaster nods, once. On the way back, she shows you claw marks on a pine, higher than any man could reach. STOP READING.

ev:69-the-weeping-shrine:a-long-night.html: The night is long, and cold, and the goddess never once looks at you. Everyone spends all of their cards. STOP READING.

ev:69-the-weeping-shrine:an-offering.html: The coins sink into the basin without a sound. For a moment, the statue's tears seem to slow. -1 curse. You made an offering. STOP READING.

ev:69-the-weeping-shrine:going-home.html: It takes all night. At dawn she stands up, stiff as an old woman, and takes the first step out of the valley. Then another. At the edge, she presses her prayer beads into your hand, and doesn't look back. -1 curse. You gain Wooden Beads (Uncommon Travel #5). You sent a pilgrim home. STOP READING.

ev:69-the-weeping-shrine:she-stays.html: She listens, and nods, and goes back to kneeling. STOP READING.

ev:69-the-weeping-shrine:something-preci.html: You lay it at her feet, among the flowers and the rusted swords and the children's toys. Nobody here will ever touch it. -1 curse. You gave her something precious. STOP READING.

ev:69-the-weeping-shrine:the-eldest-keep.html: The eldest only looks at the statue, and says nothing, for so long that you give up. STOP READING.

ev:69-the-weeping-shrine:the-goddess-smi.html:
Near dawn, when your knees have long stopped hurting and your thoughts have long stopped making sense, the statue turns her head. She looks at you, one by one, and she smiles. When the sun rises, there's a small silver pendant in the basin that wasn't there before.

You gain Adrai'lalth's Smile (Unique Travel #1). Everyone spends all of their cards. You kept the vigil. STOP READING.

ev:69-the-weeping-shrine:the-offering-bo.html: The pilgrims watch you do it, and none of them move to stop you. When you look back from the valley's edge, the statue's tears have turned red. You gain 30 gold. You robbed the shrine. STOP READING.

ev:69-the-weeping-shrine:the-pilgrims.html: You kneel in the moss beside them. Nobody speaks until nightfall, when the eldest, a woman so thin she seems made of paper, tells you she has knelt here for ninety years. She wears a Shackle too. Everyone gains 2 EXP. You sat with the pilgrims. STOP READING.

ev:69-the-weeping-shrine:the-tears.html:
If you already robbed the shrine, the water burns your throat like lye: you take an injury. STOP READING.

Otherwise, it tastes of salt, and of something much older, and every ache in you washes away. A pilgrim catches your sleeve. “Careful,” she whispers. “That's how it starts.” Recover all of your cards. +1 curse. STOP READING.

ev:69-the-weeping-shrine:the-weeping-shr.title: The Weeping Shrine
ev:69-the-weeping-shrine:the-weeping-shr.html:
Rumours

In a valley where nothing grows, a statue of Adrai'lalth weeps real tears, and the pilgrims who come to drink them never leave. A night's vigil there can win the goddess's own smile, they say, for those who can bear it.

The valley is silent: no birds, no wind, only the sound of dripping. At its heart stands a statue of Adrai'lalth, white as bone, and from her painted eyes run two thin streams of water that fill the basin at her feet. Pilgrims in grey kneel before her in rows. Some have knelt so long that moss grows on their robes. None of them look up.

Choose one
  • (Each player, once per day) Drink from the basin. GO TO the tears.
  • (Each player, once per day) Wash your wounds in the basin, without drinking. GO TO washing in the tears.
  • (Lose 20 gold, unless you already made an offering at this location) Make an offering. GO TO an offering.
  • (Lose an item of Rare rarity, unless you already gave her something precious) Lay something precious at her feet. GO TO something precious.
  • (Unless you already sat with the pilgrims) Kneel with the pilgrims. GO TO the pilgrims.
  • (If you already sat with the pilgrims, unless you already learned why she weeps) Ask the eldest pilgrim why the goddess weeps. Trial 9 MIND (Lore). If you succeed, GO TO why she weeps. If you fail, GO TO the eldest keeps silent.
  • (Unless you already kept the vigil at this location) Keep a vigil through the night. Trial 10 SOUL x player (Resolve). If you succeed, GO TO the goddess smiles. If you fail, GO TO a long night.
  • (Unless you already sent a pilgrim home) Help a young pilgrim who wants to go home, but can't make herself leave. Trial 8 SOUL (Influence). If you succeed, GO TO going home. If you fail, GO TO she stays.
  • (+1 curse) Empty the pilgrims' offering bowl. GO TO the offering bowl.
  • Leave. STOP READING.

ev:69-the-weeping-shrine:washing-in-the-.html:
If you already robbed the shrine, the water raises blisters wherever it touches: you take an injury. STOP READING.

Otherwise, the water is cold enough to make you gasp, and the cuts close under it. Recover 2 cards. STOP READING.

ev:69-the-weeping-shrine:why-she-weeps.html: The eldest is quiet for so long that you think she's fallen asleep. “She weeps,” she says at last, “because she knows what we will give her. And she takes it anyway.” She won't say any more. Everyone gains 8 EXP. You learned why she weeps. STOP READING.

ev:7-traders-miners-m:back-onto-the-raft.html: You fall back onto the raft, hard, and the ship drifts off without you. You take an injury. GO TO sail on.

ev:7-traders-miners-m:dead-man-s-chest.title: Dead Man's Chest
ev:7-traders-miners-m:dead-man-s-chest.html:
You're halfway through the hold when the hatch slams shut above you. In the captain's cabin, something starts to laugh, and the barrels begin to open from the inside.

Dead Man's Chest
Enemies
  • 4x Raised Bones (Crescent), the crew.
  • 1x Raised Commander (Quarter), the captain.
On Victory
  • 2x random Common Food item.
  • 5 exp for each player.
On Defeat
  • 8 exp for each player.

When it's over, you row away before the fog closes in again. GO TO sail on.

ev:7-traders-miners-m:deserts.title: Deserts
ev:7-traders-miners-m:deserts.html:
The wind has scoured the salt flat clean of everything but a brass lamp, half buried and polished to a mirror shine by centuries of sand. When you kneel beside it, it's warm, far warmer than the sun could make it. From inside comes a low hum, the kind of tune someone hums when they've been waiting a very long time and have given up on company.

Choose one
  • Leave it where it lies. Nothing that shiny has ever been free. STOP READING.
  • Study the script engraved around its base. Trial 5 MIND (Lore). If you succeed, GO TO read the inscription. If you fail, the script is older than any you know. Choose a different option.
  • Rub the lamp. GO TO rub the lamp.

ev:7-traders-miners-m:lost-in-the-market.html: You lose them in the market, and slip out by the back streets. Move to an adjacent location. STOP READING.

ev:7-traders-miners-m:mountains.title: Mountains
ev:7-traders-miners-m:mountains.html:
You find yourself bordering the mouth of a quarry. One bowshot away, a stocky miner sings as she operates a pulley, raising a bundle of ore from the bottom of the pit.

You hail to show you mean no harm, calling the miner's attention. She casts an alarmed glance at you and slips the rope in surprise, suppressing a gasp. Barely managing to regain control of the pulley she sinks her heels to slow down the bundle's descent.

Trial 6 MIND (Lore), If you fail, GO TO Unexpected Landslide. If you succeed, GO TO Landslide predicted.

ev:7-traders-miners-m:not-them.html: The guard looks from you to the poster and back, and waves you through, disappointed. STOP READING.

ev:7-traders-miners-m:oceans.title: Oceans
ev:7-traders-miners-m:oceans.html:
A ship drifts out of the fog with its sails in rags and nobody at the wheel. Its name has been scraped off the bow, carefully, by someone who didn't want it remembered.

Choose one
  • Let it drift past. It follows you for an hour, close enough to hear its timbers groan, then loses interest. GO TO sail on.
  • Board it. Trial 5 BODY (Athletics). If you succeed, GO TO the empty ship. If you fail, GO TO back onto the raft.

ev:7-traders-miners-m:plains.title: Plains
ev:7-traders-miners-m:plains.html:
At dusk, a column of pilgrims crests the hill and comes down the road towards you, walking two by two in perfect silence. They carry candles that give no light, and little painted icons of a goddess you know well: Adrai'lalth, the Healer. Their robes are rags and their feet are bare. So are their bones. At the head of the column, a tall figure swaddled in grey thread counts the beads of a rosary made of knuckles.

Hundreds of empty sockets pass you by without a glance. The dead are on their way to be healed.

Choose one
  • Step off the road and let them pass. STOP READING.
  • Fall in line with the pilgrims. “They're going my way.” Everyone takes a Trial 2 SOUL (Resolve). If everyone succeeds, GO TO Walking With the Dead. If anyone fails, GO TO a heartbeat among the dead.
  • (Spend a SOUL card). Pray to Adrai'lalth to grant them the rest they're walking towards. Trial 4 SOUL (Resolve). If you succeed, GO TO successful prayer. If you fail, GO TO failed prayer.
  • Draw your weapons. “Somebody has to tell them.” GO TO Pale Ambush.

ev:7-traders-miners-m:the-empty-ship.html:
The deck is empty, the galley cold, the captain's log blank from the first page to the last. Down in the hold, barrels of water and biscuit sit neatly roped, as if waiting for a crew that went ashore and forgot to come back.

Roll the luck die. If 1-4, GO TO Dead Man's Chest. If 5-10, you gain 2x random Common Food item, and row away before the fog closes in again. GO TO sail on.

ev:7-traders-miners-m:the-stag-falls.html:
The arrow flies true. The stag doesn't fall so much as settle, like a tree coming down in slow snow, and when it's still, the moss on its antlers turns to ash. The birds don't fly away. They just stop.

You carve a charm from its antlers. It's beautiful, and it never feels warm, however long you wear it.

You gain 1x random Rare Travel item and 2x Beast Meat (Common Food #7). STOP READING.

ev:7-traders-miners-m:the-stag-s-regard.html:
The stag lifts its head and looks at you for a long time. You have the uncomfortable feeling of being weighed, and the worse feeling that the Shackle is being weighed with you.

Trial 6 SOUL (Resolve). If you succeed, it bows its antlers to you, and the birds in them wake and sing. Everyone gains 3 EXP. STOP READING. If you fail, it turns away, and is gone between one step and the next. STOP READING.

ev:7-traders-miners-m:the-stag-s-road.html:
You follow the stag for hours, along paths you'd swear weren't there a moment ago, through trees that lean aside to let it pass. At dusk it stops at a spring so clear it looks empty, drinks, and walks on without you.

Each player may drink from the spring and recover a card. You and your allies may then move up to 2 locations through Woodlands. STOP READING.

ev:7-traders-miners-m:the-stag-startles.html: A twig snaps. The stag's head comes up, and in one bound it's gone. Behind it, every flower it opened closes, and the forest goes very quiet, the way a room does when someone important has been insulted. STOP READING.

ev:7-traders-miners-m:towns.title: Towns
ev:7-traders-miners-m:towns.html:
As you pass the town gate, a poster catches your eye: a face that could be yours, if you squinted, above the word WANTED. The guard comparing the two is squinting very hard.

Choose one
  • Explain that you're not them. Trial 6 MIND (Influence). If you succeed, GO TO not them. If you fail, GO TO Wanted.
  • Run for it. Trial 5 BODY (Athletics). If you succeed, GO TO lost in the market. If you fail, GO TO Wanted.
  • Draw your weapons. GO TO Wanted.

ev:7-traders-miners-m:wanted.title: Wanted
ev:7-traders-miners-m:wanted.html:
“That's them!” the guard bellows, and the gatehouse empties into the street.

Wanted
Enemies
  • 3x Royal Guard (Quarter)
On Victory
  • 4 exp for each player.
On Defeat
  • Everyone loses half their gold, rounded up, in fines.
  • 6 exp for each player.

If you killed any of the guards, +2 curse, and you search their bodies: you gain 10 gold and 1x random Uncommon Armor.

Win or lose, you're escorted to the gate: move to an adjacent location. STOP READING.

ev:7-traders-miners-m:woodlands.title: Woodlands
ev:7-traders-miners-m:woodlands.html:
A white stag is grazing in the clearing, taller than any horse. Moss hangs from its antlers, and small birds sleep in them. Wherever it steps, flowers open. It hasn't noticed you yet.

Choose one
  • Follow it at a distance. Trial 5 BODY (Cunning). If you succeed, GO TO the stag's road. If you fail, GO TO the stag startles.
  • Step into the clearing, and bow. GO TO the stag's regard.
  • (+1 curse) Nock an arrow. Trial 6 BODY. If you succeed, GO TO the stag falls. If you fail, GO TO the stag startles.

ev:70-sand-king-s-tomb:a-heavy-purse.html: The scales settle, level, and the door behind them opens. Somewhere deep in the treasury, something smells the gold on your hands, and wakes up hungry. You passed the scales, and you fed the scales gold. STOP READING.

ev:70-sand-king-s-tomb:a-light-heart.html: You lay your hand on the scales, and they weigh something that isn't your hand. For a long moment they tremble. Then they settle, level. Everyone gains 8 EXP. You passed the scales. Behind them, a door opens onto a smell of gold, and of something that eats it. STOP READING.

ev:70-sand-king-s-tomb:an-empty-tomb.html:
The treasury is bare, the needles are still, and the door asks nothing any more. The wind has already started to fill the halls with sand.

Choose one
  • (Once per day) Sift the sand for what the thieves dropped. GO TO sifting the sand.
  • Leave. STOP READING.

ev:70-sand-king-s-tomb:found-wanting.html: The scales tip against you, and something in your chest goes cold, and stays cold. +1 curse. STOP READING.

ev:70-sand-king-s-tomb:sand-king-s-tomb.title: Sand King's Tomb
ev:70-sand-king-s-tomb:sand-king-s-tomb.html:
Rumours

Half buried in the dunes lies the tomb of a king who couldn't bear to part with his gold, even in death. Thieves go in every year. Every year, the sand gives a few of them back, and none of them are carrying anything.

The tomb rises out of the dunes in broad steps of yellow stone, polished smooth by the wind. Bones lie scattered on the steps, some of them still wearing boots. At the top, a door of black stone shows a crowned king holding a pair of scales. It stands open, as if expecting guests.

If you already emptied the treasury, GO TO an empty tomb.

Choose one
  • (Unless you already crossed the Hall of Needles) Cross the Hall of Needles. Trial 7 BODY (Athletics). If you succeed, GO TO through the needles. If you fail, GO TO the needles.
  • (If you already crossed the Hall of Needles, unless you already answered the door) Answer the Door That Asks. Trial 10 MIND (Lore). If you succeed, GO TO the door opens. If you fail, GO TO the wrong answer.
  • (If you already answered the door, unless you already passed the scales) Lay your heart on the Scales. Trial 12 SOUL (Resolve). If you succeed, GO TO a light heart. If you fail, GO TO found wanting.
  • (Lose 20 gold, if you already answered the door, unless you already passed the scales) Weigh the Scales down with gold instead. GO TO a heavy purse.
  • (If you already passed the scales) Enter the treasury. GO TO the treasury.
  • Leave. STOP READING.

links.clause: If you already emptied the treasury
if you already answered the door
If you already passed the scales) Enter the treasury

ev:70-sand-king-s-tomb:sifting-the-sand.html: Roll the luck die. If 1-6, you find nothing but bones. STOP READING. If 7-10, you gain 1x random Uncommon item. STOP READING.

ev:70-sand-king-s-tomb:the-door-opens.html: The door asks its riddle in a voice like pouring sand: “I have a crown and no head, and a hoard and no hands. What am I?” When you answer, it swings open without a sound. Everyone gains 5 EXP. You answered the door. Beyond it, in a hall of gold leaf, stands a pair of scales as tall as a man. STOP READING.

ev:70-sand-king-s-tomb:the-needles.html: The needles find you. You stagger back out into the sunlight, looking like a pincushion. You take 2 injuries. STOP READING.

ev:70-sand-king-s-tomb:the-treasury.html:
The Sand King's treasury is a hall of gold: coins in drifts like sand, crowns stacked like plates. On a throne of coins sits something that was never a king. It's eating.

The King's Hunger
Enemies
  • 1x Greed Eater (Crescent if you fed the scales gold, Full Moon otherwise)
  • 3x Raised Bones (Quarter), the king's servants.
On Victory
  • You emptied the treasury.
  • The king's sword: Radiant Crescent (Unique Weapon #2).
  • 30 gold, as much as you can carry.
  • 8 exp for each player.
On Defeat
  • 12 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:70-sand-king-s-tomb:the-wrong-answer.html: The door sighs, and the floor tips you down a chute of sand, all the way back to the steps outside. Everyone takes an injury. STOP READING.

ev:70-sand-king-s-tomb:through-the-needl.html: You dance through the hall as the needles hiss out of the walls, a heartbeat behind you. At the far end sits the last thief to get this far, his purse in his lap. He won't be needing it. You gain 6 gold. Everyone gains 5 EXP. You crossed the Hall of Needles. Beyond the hall waits a door with a mouth. STOP READING.

ev:71-saltwind:a-dropped-crate.html: The crate slips, and lands on your foot. The foreman pays you anyway, out of pity. You gain 2 gold. You take an injury. STOP READING.

ev:71-saltwind:a-good-day-s-work.html: By sundown your back aches, and your purse doesn't. You gain 6 gold. STOP READING.

ev:71-saltwind:an-empty-net.html: The moon eels don't rise tonight. The sea is cold, and so are you. Everyone spends a card. STOP READING.

ev:71-saltwind:press-ganged.html: The last thing you remember is a very friendly sailor buying the next round. You wake up in a hammock, and the floor is moving. You're aboard a merchant cog, and you're bound for your destination: the nearest town with a landing, other than Saltwind. Every sector the ship sails takes you closer to it. GO TO the merchant cog sails.

ev:71-saltwind:sailors-talk.html: The sailors drink to your health, then to theirs, then to the sea, which doesn't drink to anyone. Everyone gains 1 EXP. Choose any special location on the map next to an Ocean, and read its rumours. STOP READING.

ev:71-saltwind:saltwind.title: Saltwind
ev:71-saltwind:saltwind.html:
Rumours

Saltwind is a harbour town of tar, gulls and salt fish, where anyone with coin can find a ship, and anyone without can find work on the docks. Its sailors know every coast there is, and they'll tell you all about it for the price of a drink.

You smell Saltwind before you see it: tar, fish and seaweed, on a wind that never stops. The town tumbles down a cliff to a harbour full of masts. Nobody looks twice at the Shackle here. Sailors have seen stranger things.

Saltwind counts as a Town: resting here has no penalty.

Choose one
  • (2 gold, once per day) Buy the sailors a round. GO TO sailors' talk.
  • (Each player, once per day) Work the docks. Trial 6 BODY (Might). If you succeed, GO TO a good day's work. If you fail, GO TO a dropped crate.
  • Visit the fish market. GO TO the fish market.
  • Visit the ship's chandler. GO TO the chandler.
  • (5 gold, once per day) Play dice at the Drowned Man. GO TO the Drowned Man.
  • Go down to the harbour. In Saltwind, you don't need to wait for Lay of the Land. GO TO the harbour.
  • (Unless you already claimed the bounty) Take the harbourmaster's bounty on the pirates. GO TO the bounty.
  • (Once per day) Sail with the night fleet, after moon eels. Trial 9 MIND x player (Lore). If you succeed, GO TO the moon eels rise. If you fail, GO TO an empty net.
  • Leave. STOP READING.

ev:71-saltwind:the-bounty.html:
The harbourmaster points at a black hulk anchored at the mouth of the bay. “The Gull. She takes one ship in five. Bring me her captain's hat, and I'll make it worth your while.” Even from here, you can count more crossbows on her rail than a hulk has any right to.

The Black Gull
Enemies
  • 1x Ringleader (Full Moon), the captain.
  • 3x Bandit (Quarter), the crew.
  • 2x Bandit (Crescent), the crossbows on the rail.
On Victory
  • You claimed the bounty.
  • The bounty and the captain's purse: 35 gold.
  • 8 exp for each player.
On Defeat
  • 12 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:71-saltwind:the-chandler.html:
Rope, tar, lanterns, and one of everything a sailor might ever need, hanging from the rafters.

ItemPrice
Compass (Common Travel #3)Item value
Spyglass (Rare Travel #4)Item value
Navigation Charts (Rare Travel #1)Item value

Once you're done trading, STOP READING.

ev:71-saltwind:the-drowned-man.html: The Drowned Man is dark, loud, and smells of spilled rum. The dice are loaded, but only a little. Roll the luck die. If 1, GO TO press-ganged. If 2-6, you lose your stake. STOP READING. If 7-9, you gain 10 gold. STOP READING. If 10, you gain 20 gold. STOP READING.

ev:71-saltwind:the-fish-market.html:
Everything the sea gave up this morning, laid out on ice and shouted about.

ItemPrice
2x Horned Salmon (Uncommon Food #2)Item value
Shimmerscale (Uncommon Food #5)Item value
Lobster (Rare Food #4)Item value
Thunderbass (Rare Food #5)Item value

Once you're done trading, STOP READING.

ev:71-saltwind:the-moon-eels-rise.html: Far out, where the water turns silver, something long and pale rises to the lanterns. It takes the whole crew to haul it in, and the whole fleet cheers. You gain Moon Eel (Unique Food #1). STOP READING.

ev:72-smugglers-cove:a-bribe.html: The sergeant pockets it without looking at you, and looks the other way for exactly as long as it takes you to leave. STOP READING.

ev:72-smugglers-cove:a-lucky-night.html: A smuggler who has had far too much rum loses a wager to you, and pays with the only thing he has left. You gain 1x random Rare item. STOP READING.

ev:72-smugglers-cove:a-smuggler-s-route.html:
A captain with a patch over one eye offers you a place on tonight's run.

Choose one
  • (5 gold for each player) Sail with her. GO TO the night run.
  • Leave. STOP READING.

ev:72-smugglers-cove:mother-brine.html:
Mother Brine sits on a barrel, smoking a pipe and knitting something that might be a net. She buys anything, and sells whatever she has.

ItemPrice
2x random Uncommon itemHalf its value

She buys any item for half its value. Once you're done trading, STOP READING.

ev:72-smugglers-cove:sealed-crates.html: A smuggler is selling crates off a wreck, still sealed. No questions, and no refunds. You may buy up to 3 crates, for 10 gold each. For each one, roll the luck die. If 1-4, seawater and sand. If 5-8, you gain 1x random Uncommon item. If 9-10, you gain 1x random Rare item. STOP READING.

ev:72-smugglers-cove:smugglers-cove.title: Smugglers' Cove
ev:72-smugglers-cove:smugglers-cove.html:
Rumours

Everyone knows about the cove where the smugglers land, and nobody admits it. Anything can be bought there, for a price, on a good night. On a bad night, you're what gets sold.

A goat track winds down the cliffs to a cove you'd never see from the sea. Lanterns bob in the dark below, and boats slide in and out without lights. A man with a crossbow and a very good memory for faces watches you come down.

If you already sold out the cove, GO TO the cove remembers.

Choose one
  • Go down to the beach, and see what the night brings. GO TO tonight in the cove.
  • (+1 curse) Sell the cove's secrets to the Royal Guard. GO TO an informer.
  • Leave. STOP READING.

links.clause: If you already sold out the cove

ev:72-smugglers-cove:the-alley.html:
Three smugglers step out of the dark between two shacks. “Your purses,” says the one with the knife. “Or your fingers.”

Choose one
  • (Everyone loses 5 gold) Pay them. STOP READING.
  • Fight. GO TO A Knife in the Dark.

ev:72-smugglers-cove:the-black-market.html:
A boat has come in from somewhere hot, and its hold is open for business. Nobody here cares about the Shackle.

ItemPrice
1x random Rare WeaponItem value
1x random Rare ArmorItem value
1x random Rare PotionItem value
1x random Rare Travel itemItem value

Once you're done trading, STOP READING.

ev:72-smugglers-cove:the-night-run.html: You sail without lights, and land before dawn on a beach that isn't on any map. You and your allies may move to any location on the map next to an Ocean. STOP READING.

ev:72-smugglers-cove:the-raid.html:
Whistles shriek from the cliffs, and the Royal Guard comes down the goat track with torches.

Choose one
  • (Lose 10 gold) Bribe the sergeant. GO TO a bribe.
  • Hide among the boats. Trial 7 BODY (Cunning). If you succeed, GO TO unseen. If you fail, GO TO Caught in the Cove.
  • Fight your way out. GO TO Caught in the Cove.

ev:72-smugglers-cove:tonight-in-the-cove.html:
Roll the luck die:

RollTonight
1The Royal Guard raids the cove. GO TO the raid
2A knife in an alley. GO TO the alley
3-4Mother Brine is buying. GO TO Mother Brine
5-6A boat from the south. GO TO the black market
7-8Crates off a wreck. GO TO sealed crates
9A captain needs a crew. GO TO a smuggler's route
10A lucky night. GO TO a lucky night

ev:72-smugglers-cove:unseen.html: The guards march right past you, arrest three smugglers and a goat, and leave. STOP READING.

ev:8-knight-errant:a-duel.html:
The knight dismounts, out of courtesy, and salutes you with his sword.

A Matter of Honor
Enemies
  • 1x Ironclad Soldier (Quarter), the knight.
Rules
  • Only the player who accepted the duel fights. The others watch: they don't play cards, and can't be targeted.
On Victory
  • The knight yields, and pays his forfeit: 10 gold.
  • 4 exp for each player.
On Defeat
  • 6 exp for each player.

After the duel, STOP READING.

ev:8-knight-errant:a-hare-for-the-pot.html: It's a fat one, too. You gain Beast Meat (Common Food #7). GO TO Caught in the Act.

ev:8-knight-errant:before-the-wind.html: The storm flings you across the waves for a night and a day. GO TO adrift.

ev:8-knight-errant:caught-in-the-act.title: Caught in the Act
ev:8-knight-errant:caught-in-the-act.html:
“Oi!” The poachers step out of the trees with their bows drawn. They don't look like people who ask twice.

Caught in the Act
Enemies
  • 4x Poacher (Quarter)
On Victory
  • Beast Meat (Common Food #7).
  • 1x random Common Weapon.
  • 3 exp for each player.
On Defeat
  • 5 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:8-knight-errant:crossed-off.html: He consults a little book, crosses something out, and rides on. Everyone gains 1 EXP. STOP READING.

ev:8-knight-errant:cutting-them-loose.html: The animals bolt for the trees. One or two even look back, as if to say thank you. Everyone gains 1 EXP. GO TO Caught in the Act.

ev:8-knight-errant:deserts.title: Deserts
ev:8-knight-errant:deserts.html:
The sandstorm hits like a wall. Somewhere inside it, something laughs: the high, yipping laughter of dune jackals, who hunt in storms because their prey can't see them coming.

Choose one
  • Hunker down, back to back. Trial 5 BODY (Might). If you succeed, GO TO the laughter moves on. If you fail, GO TO No Laughing Matter.
  • Go out and meet them. GO TO No Laughing Matter.

ev:8-knight-errant:knight-errant.title: Knight Errant
ev:8-knight-errant:knight-errant.html:
The knight sighs, lowers his visor, and whistles. His squires come running from behind a hedge, rather more of them than a knight strictly needs.

Knight Errant
Enemies
  • 1x Ironclad Soldier (Crescent), the knight, charging.
  • 2x Ironclad Protector (Quarter), his squires.
On Victory
  • 1x random Uncommon Armor.
  • 4 exp for each player.
On Defeat
  • 6 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:8-knight-errant:mountains.title: Mountains
ev:8-knight-errant:mountains.html:
An old forge clings to a ledge, its doors torn off their hinges. The fire went out years ago, but the smoke never left. It's sitting in the corner, and it's watching you.

Choose one
  • Back away slowly. Trial 5 SOUL (Resolve). If you succeed, the smoke lets you go, this time. STOP READING. If you fail, GO TO The Cold Forge.
  • Go in. There might be something left worth taking. GO TO The Cold Forge.

ev:8-knight-errant:no-laughing-matter.title: No Laughing Matter
ev:8-knight-errant:no-laughing-matter.html:
They come out of the dust all at once, lean and grinning, more teeth than dog.

No Laughing Matter
Enemies
  • 4x Dire Wolf (Crescent), the jackals.
Rules
  • The storm blinds everyone: -1 accuracy to every attack.
On Victory
  • 3 exp for each player.
On Defeat
  • Players lose 1x Food item.
  • 5 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:8-knight-errant:oceans.title: Oceans
ev:8-knight-errant:oceans.html:
The sky turns green, then black. The first wave to break over the raft is warm; the second is ice-cold, and takes half your supplies with it.

Everyone spends a card. Anyone who can't takes an injury instead. Then:

Choose one
  • Run before the wind, and let it take you where it will. GO TO before the wind.
  • Read the swells, and steer between them. Trial 7 MIND (Lore). If you succeed, GO TO on course. If you fail, GO TO Shipwrecked.

ev:8-knight-errant:on-course.html: You ride out the storm, battered but on course. GO TO sail on.

ev:8-knight-errant:plains.title: Plains
ev:8-knight-errant:plains.html:
A knight in dented armor blocks the road, visor up, lance at rest. “Good morrow! I have sworn to rid the world of one Shackled every day, and I'm afraid you're today's.” He sounds genuinely apologetic.

Choose one
  • Accept his challenge: one of you will face him alone. GO TO a duel.
  • Convince him you're not worth his oath. Trial 6 SOUL (Influence). If you succeed, GO TO crossed off. If you fail, GO TO Knight Errant.
  • Refuse. GO TO Knight Errant.

ev:8-knight-errant:the-cold-forge.title: The Cold Forge
ev:8-knight-errant:the-cold-forge.html:
The smoke stands up. It's much bigger standing up. Out of the ash heaps in the hearth, smaller shapes with a great many teeth come skittering to join it.

The Cold Forge
Enemies
  • 2x Soot Biter (Crescent)
  • 1x Soot Devourer (Quarter)
On Victory
  • The smith's last work: 1x random Uncommon Weapon.
  • 4 exp for each player.
On Defeat
  • 6 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:8-knight-errant:the-laughter-moves-on.html: The laughter circles you for an hour, then goes looking for easier prey. STOP READING.

ev:8-knight-errant:towns.title: Towns
ev:8-knight-errant:towns.html:
Right as you're about to turn a corner, an interesting bit of conversation between a small group of townsfolk reaches your ear. The Shackle stirs like a sleeping hound, beckoning you to pay attention to the words, so you flatten yourself against the wall in full attention.

Trial 4 BODY + MIND (Cunning). If you succeed, GO TO overheard rumours. If you fail, one of them notices your shadow on the wall, and the conversation stops dead. So do the smiles. STOP READING.

ev:8-knight-errant:woodlands.title: Woodlands
ev:8-knight-errant:woodlands.html:
Snares line the game trail, dozens of them, and every one has caught something. Most of the somethings are still alive, and all of them are looking at you.

Choose one
  • Cut them loose. GO TO cutting them loose.
  • Help yourself to a hare. GO TO a hare for the pot.
  • Leave the trail. STOP READING.

ev:9-procession-of-bones:a-path-of-memor.html: It leads you out by a path that's gone as soon as you've used it. Move to any location up to 2 locations away. STOP READING.

ev:9-procession-of-bones:a-road-through-.html: From the top, you spot a road through the canopy, and it's even where you left it. Move to any adjacent location. STOP READING.

ev:9-procession-of-bones:by-a-nose.html:
You win by a nose. A camel's nose, which is a considerable margin.

Everyone gains 2 EXP. You and your allies may move up to 3 locations through Deserts on the camels. STOP READING.

ev:9-procession-of-bones:deeper-in.html:
You walk until the light turns green and the birdsong stops, and the forest folds itself around you like a letter.

Everyone spends a card. Then move to a random adjacent location, up to 3 times, stopping as soon as you're out of the Woodlands. STOP READING.

ev:9-procession-of-bones:deserts.title: Deserts
ev:9-procession-of-bones:deserts.html:
You crest a dune to find the water nomads racing camels across the salt flat below, and one of their teams is a rider short. The prize is the loan of the winning camels, for as long as you need them today.

Choose one
  • Ride. Trial 6 BODY (Athletics). If you succeed, GO TO by a nose. If you fail, GO TO thrown.
  • (Bet up to 10 gold) Bet on the race. GO TO the bet.
  • Watch, and move on. STOP READING.

ev:9-procession-of-bones:flowers-for-him.html: “Keep it,” you tell her. “Buy him some flowers.” -1 curse. STOP READING.

ev:9-procession-of-bones:half-the-reward.html: She counts out half, coin by coin, as if each one hurts her. You gain 8 gold. STOP READING.

ev:9-procession-of-bones:mountains.title: Mountains
ev:9-procession-of-bones:mountains.html: Your weary steps carry you to a wide promontory, exposed to the elements under the full expanse of the skies. A powerful gust sweeps the headland, threatening to lift you off your feet. GO TO a gust of wind.

ev:9-procession-of-bones:oceans.title: Oceans
ev:9-procession-of-bones:oceans.html: The wind begins to falter. Gusts come further and further apart, and the sail sags between them like washing on a still day. GO TO becalmed.

ev:9-procession-of-bones:one-step.html: It takes your hand, and one step later you're somewhere else entirely. Move to any location on the map. STOP READING.

ev:9-procession-of-bones:plains.title: Plains
ev:9-procession-of-bones:plains.html:
The sweeping wind carries the sound of a whinny. You stay downwind and peek over a hill, careful to keep your shape obscured by the tall grass, and spot a pack of wild horses grazing a hundred paces down.

Choose one
  • Peacefully observe the beasts as they trot away. GO TO observe the beasts.
  • Nock an arrow on your hunting bow. "Looks like I am eating well tonight". Trial 5 BODY (Athletics). GO TO hunt beasts.
  • Approach the pack silently. Trial 6 BODY (Cunning) GO TO sneak up to the horses.
  • (Spend a Food item) Lure the horses. GO TO lure the horses.

ev:9-procession-of-bones:shown-out.html: She has you shown out, with nothing. STOP READING.

ev:9-procession-of-bones:the-bet.html: The camels are off in a cloud of dust and spit. Roll the luck die. If 7-10, you win as much as you bet. Otherwise, you lose it. STOP READING.

ev:9-procession-of-bones:the-countess-pa.html:
The Countess counts out your reward, notices the Shackle, and stops counting. “Oh,” she says. “I didn't realise. The reward was for champions, you understand. Not for... your sort.”

Choose one
  • Accept half. GO TO half the reward.
  • Insist on the full sum. Trial 6 MIND (Influence). If you succeed, GO TO the full sum. If you fail, GO TO shown out.
  • Refuse her money. GO TO flowers for him.

ev:9-procession-of-bones:the-countess-s-.html:
The Countess receives you in black. “My late husband,” she says, “has not been as late as one would like. He keeps coming up for dinner.” Below the house, the crypt door is scratched from the inside.

Till Death Do Us Part
Enemies
  • 4x Raised Bones (Quarter), the Count's ancestors.
  • 1x Weaver of Bone (Full Moon), the late Count.
On Victory
  • 5 exp for each player.
On Defeat
  • 8 exp for each player.

If you won, GO TO the Countess pays. If you lost, STOP READING.

ev:9-procession-of-bones:the-full-sum.html: She pays in full, with a look that could curdle milk. You gain 16 gold. STOP READING.

ev:9-procession-of-bones:the-stump-s-bar.html:
The stump unfolds into something small and bark-skinned, with a great many knees. “Lost?” it says, delighted. “I can fix that. For a price, of course. Everything has a price.”

Choose one
  • (Spend 2 cards) Pay with a memory or two. GO TO a path of memories.
  • (+1 curse) Pay with a little piece of your soul. GO TO one step.
  • Refuse, and find your own way. GO TO deeper in.

ev:9-procession-of-bones:thrown.html: The camel finishes the race without you, and the salt flat is harder than it looks. You take an injury. STOP READING.

ev:9-procession-of-bones:towns.title: Towns
ev:9-procession-of-bones:towns.html:
A herald reads a proclamation in the square: the Countess requires champions, discreet ones, for a matter concerning the family crypt. The reward is generous. The herald doesn't say what the matter is, and nobody in the crowd seems keen to ask.

Choose one
  • Offer your services. GO TO the Countess's crypt.
  • Let someone else be discreet. STOP READING.

ev:9-procession-of-bones:woodlands.title: Woodlands
ev:9-procession-of-bones:woodlands.html:
The trees all look the same. Then they all look like the same tree. You've passed that stump three times now, and the third time, you're fairly sure it waved.

Choose one
  • Climb a tree to get your bearings. Trial 5 BODY (Athletics). If you succeed, GO TO a road through the canopy. If you fail, GO TO deeper in.
  • Wave back at the stump. GO TO the stump's bargain.
  • Keep walking. GO TO deeper in.

ev:aux-bandit-ambush-stores:ambush-the-b.html: Everyone takes a Trial 2 BODY (Cunning). If everyone succeeds, GO TO successful ambush. If anyone fails, GO TO failed ambush.

ev:aux-bandit-ambush-stores:charge.html:
You decide your best approach is a direct one. Your raised weapon catches the moonlight as you let out a warcry. The bandits jump from their hiding place, visibly startled, as you rush down the hill with determination.

GO TO Moonlit Ambush.

ev:aux-bandit-ambush-stores:failed-ambus.html:
You crawl in absolute silence, muscles tensing with anticipation, until the beat of your heart rises to drown the sounds of the night.

Suddenly, a bandit lets out a cry of warning, followed by the din of several blades leaving their scabbards. You stand up in an adrenaline-fueled rush, but know well you're on the back foot.

GO TO Moonlit Ambush.

ev:aux-bandit-ambush-stores:moonlit-ambu.title: Moonlit Ambush
ev:aux-bandit-ambush-stores:moonlit-ambu.html:
Roadside bandits
Enemies
  • 4x Bandit.
  • 3x Ironclad Soldier.
Rules
  • If you successfully ambushed the bandits, all enemies begin in Full Moon phase.
  • If you failed to ambush the bandits, or they ambushed you, all enemies begin in Crescent phase.
  • If you charged at the bandits, all enemies begin in Quarter phase.
On Victory
  • 6 exp for each player.
  • 4x common random item.
  • 2x uncommon random item.
On Defeat
  • 9xp for each player.

After the encounter ends, STOP READING.

ev:aux-bandit-ambush-stores:successful-a.html:
You crawl in absolute silence, muscles tensing with anticipation, until the beat of your heart rises to drown the sounds of the night. You're close enough to touch the bandits now, and you can't help but smile at the predators turned clueless prey.

You rise to a crouch, weapon in hand.

ev:aux-bone-weaver-s-barrow:a-good-bout.html: He fights the way the old songs say, and teaches like a patient father. You gain 5 EXP. STOP READING.

ev:aux-bone-weaver-s-barrow:knocked-flat.html: He knocks you flat, kindly. You gain 2 EXP. STOP READING.

ev:aux-bone-weaver-s-barrow:the-champion.html: His sword wavers, and lowers. He can't disobey his master, but he steps aside. You passed the champion, and the champion kept his oath. STOP READING.

ev:aux-bone-weaver-s-barrow:the-king-s-c.html: It's heavier than it looks. You gain 35 gold. You took the crown. If the champion kept his oath, he watches you go, and doesn't stop you. When you come back, he's gone: cross out the champion kept his oath. STOP READING.

ev:aux-bone-weaver-s-barrow:the-quiet-ba.html:
The barrow is only a tomb again. The king sleeps with his crown on his chest, and the grass outside has begun to stand up.

Choose one
  • (Each player, once per day, if the champion kept his oath) Train with the champion, who keeps his watch free now. Trial 9 BODY (Might). If you succeed, GO TO a good bout. If you fail, GO TO knocked flat.
  • (+1 curse, unless you already took the crown at this location) Take the king's crown. GO TO the king's crown.
  • Leave. STOP READING.

ev:aux-deepforge:the-deep-road.html:
The deep road runs down into the dark for miles, past forges gone cold and halls gone silent. The soot grows thicker with every step. Then it starts to move.

Smoke in the Deep
Enemies
  • 5x Soot Biter (Quarter)
On Victory
  • You cleared the deep road.
  • 6 gold, from a dead smith's purse.
  • 5 exp for each player.
On Defeat
  • 8 exp for each player.

If you won, you can see a glow at the end of the road. Not fire, but something that remembers being fire. STOP READING.

ev:aux-deepforge:the-old-forge.html:
The Old Forge is a cavern the size of a cathedral, and its hearth is a pit of cold ash. The ash is breathing. As you step towards it, the whole heap rises, and keeps rising, and looks down at you with eyes like dying coals.

The Cold Heart
Enemies
  • 1x Soot Devourer (Full Moon)
  • 3x Soot Biter (Crescent), summoned by the Devourer.
On Victory
  • You light the torch in the hearth: you rekindled the Old Forge. Cross out the Council's torch.
  • The clans' thanks: 15 gold, and Alchemical Skin (Unique Armor #3), the first thing forged in the Old Forge in a thousand years.
  • 8 exp for each player.
On Defeat
  • 12 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:aux-drunken-mob-trap-chest:avoiding-t.html:
You freeze mid-stride, heart pumping as you note how greed nearly cost you a leg. The menacing jaws of a bear trap lay open between you and the chest, obscured by the foliage.

You carefully skirt around the contraption. GO TO Opening a common chest.

ev:aux-drunken-mob-trap-chest:booby-trap.html:
Roll the luck die:

  • (1-4) Continue Reading
  • (5-10) GO TO avoiding the trap

THWACK! A jolt of burning pain overtakes your mind, traveling all the way up from your calf. You look down in a pained grimace, finding the wicked teeth of a bear trap deeply embedded in your left leg.

Take an injury. Trial 4 SOUL (Resolve). If you fail, you succumb to pain and take another injury in your wild thrashing.

*Once the pain finally subsides, you drag yourself to the chest, panting. After this ordeal, you best have something to show for it at least.

ev:aux-drunken-mob-trap-chest:drunken-fi.html:
You adopt a fighting stance with a sigh of resignation. If you don't want to be exiled from this town, you'll have to show some restraint to these poor bastards.

Drunken Mob
Enemies
  • Full Moon:(4 + 1 per 10 Curse) Drunken Townsfolk.
  • Quarter: (2 + 1 per 20 Curse) Brawler.
Rules
  • At the end of each round, before drift, every enemy on square 1 is knocked out: remove it from the fight. You win when no enemies are left.
  • Enemies that go past square 1 die as usual. Killing anyone will have consequences.
On Victory
  • 4 exp for each player.
On Defeat
  • 6xp for each player.

If you killed anyone, +2 curse, and you're run out of town. Hopefully, next time, they won't remember you. Move to a random adjacent location. STOP READING.

Otherwise, STOP READING.

ev:aux-drunken-mob-trap-chest:opening-a-.html:
You grab the side handles and pull, opening the chest with a satisfying creak.

Roll the luck die:

RollYou find
14 gold.
2-32x random Common Items.
4-52x random Common items + 4 gold.
6-71x random Uncommon item.
8-91x random Uncommon item + 6 gold.
103x random Uncommon items.

STOP READING.

ev:aux-emberskitter-nest:her-silk.html: Molten glass, cooled into threads as fine as hair. Merchants pay well for it, and don't ask where it came from. You gain 6 gold. STOP READING.

ev:aux-emberskitter-nest:the-cold-nest.html:
The glass has cooled to black, the clicking has stopped, and the caravans have started using the old road again.

Choose one
  • (Once per day) Gather her silk. GO TO her silk.
  • Shelter in the tunnels, which stay cool at night. GO TO the cool tunnels.
  • Leave. STOP READING.

ev:aux-emberskitter-nest:the-cool-tunnel.html: Nothing clicks in the dark any more. If you rest before leaving, you rest sheltered, and don't pay the Desert's extra cards. STOP READING.
